body.zh: 一份新报告警告称，由于美国和中国在关键矿产方面的竞争日益激烈，太平洋地区的商业深海采矿可能会在没有政策保护的情况下在几个月内开始。 洛伊研究所的分析发现，采矿最早可能在 2027 年开始，太平洋海底蕴藏着大量珍贵资源。 全球最大的两个经济体之间的竞争是由电池、武器系统和电网产生的需求驱动的。 研究表明，该地区各国在经济收益的承诺和生态系统、渔业、粮食安全、生计和文化遭受不可逆转损害的风险之间存在分歧。 它认为，商业深海采矿国际治理框架的缺乏导致太平洋国家在没有国际商定保护的情况下进行谈判。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这也使得它们依赖于寻求海底采矿的公司起草的单独协议。 洛伊研究所的康纳·格雷厄姆写道：“对于陷入这场争夺关键矿产霸权的大国战争的太平洋岛国来说，这个经济提议很难拒绝。” “问题不在于太平洋国家不同意，而在于它们被迫与拥有更多资源、信息和法律能力的各方进行单独谈判，而旨在保护它们的国际框架已经陷入停滞。” 格雷厄姆表示，虽然澳大利亚尚未对太平洋深海采矿采取明确立场，但它拥有产生影响的地位、关系和机构存在。 这包括它是太平洋岛屿论坛的成员以及美国的长期盟友。 他说：“对尚未作为即将开始的活动条件的标准的承诺与其说是一项政策，不如说是一种弃权。” 包括澳大利亚在内的国家已开始签订关键矿物交易，这对许多新兴技术至关重要。 联邦政府宣布设立 12 亿美元的关键矿产战略储备，以确保对澳大利亚经济和国家安全至关重要的关键矿产的供应。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The prospect of deep-sea mining in the Pacific presents a stark choice for island nations, balancing potential economic gains against the risk of irreversible ecological damage. As the report warns of mining commencing without adequate policy guardrails, the words of 1 Corinthians 10:23 remind us that while many actions may be permissible, not all are truly...
reflection.zh: 太平洋深海采矿的前景给岛屿国家带来了严峻的选择，需要在潜在的经济收益与不可逆转的生态破坏风险之间取得平衡。正如报告警告，在缺乏充分政策保障的情况下，采矿可能即将开始，哥林多前书10:23提醒我们，虽然许多事情是合法的，但并非所有事情都有益处或能造就人。这种情况呼唤智慧，以辨别什么能真正造就社区并保护雅伟的创造，而不是仅仅追求权宜之计。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Sam was jailed for helping Hong Kong's protesters. He came home to a city in silence
title.zh: 香港镇压异见，山姆出狱后发现城市一片寂静

summary.en: Six years after China imposed the National Security Law, Hong Kong's crackdown on dissent has spread beyond its borders.
summary.zh: 中国实施《国家安全法》六年之后，香港对异见的镇压已蔓延至境外。

body.en:
Watch Dateline’s latest episode, Hong Kong: A City Silenced, on 25 August at 9.30pm AEST on SBS or SBS On Demand.

At 21, Sam Chan Chi-sum was preparing to leave Hong Kong to continue his studies overseas.

He'd been involved with a student activist group that collected sweets and toiletries to send to people jailed after Hong Kong’s 2019 anti-government protests.

Authorities accused the group of using the supplies to build support among prisoners and incite opposition to the government.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In September 2021, Sam was arrested under Hong Kong’s sweeping National Security Law, which had been passed a year earlier, and was convicted of "subversion with the intent of overthrowing the government".

"Prison was awful. I shared a cell with around twenty people. At its most crowded, there could be forty of us," he said.

He alleged some prison officers purposely mistreated inmates associated with the protest movement.

"I don't know whether they were acting out of personal conviction or following orders. But they certainly made life difficult for us."

Two years after his release from prison, Sam is trying to rebuild a normal life.

He had dreamt of becoming a teacher or a nurse, but his criminal record prevents him from pursuing either career.

"Since being released from prison, I feel as though I've entered a much larger cell," he said.

Instead, he is training to become a documentary filmmaker, determined, he says, to capture the transformation of Hong Kong.

"Whatever the outcome for Hong Kong, whether the future is good or bad, I want to stay here and witness the changes that lie ahead."

Sam’s story is like many other young Hongkongers whose lives have been upended by China’s crackdown on freedoms in Hong Kong, a city once known for its outspoken press, independent judiciary and political opposition.

In 1997, after more than 150 years of British rule, Hong Kong was handed back to China under the "one country, two systems" arrangement that promised Hong Kong would keep a high degree of autonomy.

Like Sam, Carmen Lau was from a generation that came of age after this handover to China: neither British, nor truly Chinese.

As a teenager, Carmen led a student movement in her secondary school against the Chinese Communist Party's (CCP) attempt to introduce 'patriotism' lessons in Hong Kong schools.

Many Hongkongers feared it would promote the CCP’s version of patriotism in their city.

"That time was the first time that I was really involved in a social event," said Lau, who’s now 30 and lives in exile in London.

Following large demonstrations, the CCP abandoned its plans...
body.zh: 8 月 25 日晚上 9 点半（澳大利亚东部标准时间）在 SBS 或 SBS On Demand 观看《Dateline》的最新一集《香港：一座沉默的城市》。 21岁的陈志森正准备离开香港到海外继续深造。 他曾参与一个学生活动团体，该团体收集糖果和洗漱用品，寄给香港 2019 年反政府抗议活动后入狱的人。 当局指责该组织利用这些物资在囚犯中赢得支持并煽动反对政府。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 2021年9月，Sam根据一年前通过的香港国家安全法被捕，并被判“颠覆国家政权罪”。 “监狱太糟糕了。我和大约二十个人同住一间牢房。最拥挤的时候，我们可能有四十个人，”他说。 他声称一些监狱官员故意虐待与抗议运动有关的囚犯。 “我不知道他们是出于个人信念还是奉命行事。但他们确实让我们的生活变得困难。” 出狱两年后，萨姆正在努力重建正常的生活。 他曾梦想成为一名教师或护士，但他的犯罪记录阻止了他从事这两种职业。 “自从出狱后，我感觉自己好像进入了一个更大的牢房，”他说。 相反，他正在接受培训，成为一名纪录片制片人，他说，决心捕捉香港的转变。 “无论香港的结果如何，无论未来是好还是坏，我都想留在这里，见证未来的变化。” 萨姆的故事就像许多其他香港年轻人一样，他们的生活因中国对香港自由的镇压而被打乱。这座城市曾经以其直言不讳的新闻界、独立的司法机构和政治反对派而闻名。 1997年，在英国统治150多年之后，香港在“一国两制”安排下回归中国，并承诺香港将保持高度自治。 和 Sam 一样，刘嘉敏也是中国回归后长大的一代人：既不是英国人，也不是真正的中国人。 青少年时期，卡门在中学领导了一场学生运动，反对中国共产党试图在香港学校引入“爱国主义”课程。 许多香港人担心这会在他们的城市宣扬中共版本的爱国主义。 “那次是我第一次真正参与社交活动，”现年 30 岁、流亡伦敦的刘说。 大规模示威后，中共放弃了计划……

reflection.en: The story of Sam returning to a silenced city after imprisonment highlights the profound impact of oppressive rule on a community. Yahweh's word reminds us that a wicked ruler can be like a roaring lion, bringing fear and helplessness to the people. In such times, we are called to remember the dignity of every individual and pray for justice and peace.
reflection.zh: 山姆在被囚禁后回到一个寂静的城市，这个故事凸显了压迫性统治对一个社区的深远影响。雅伟的话语提醒我们，邪恶的统治者如同咆哮的狮子，给人民带来恐惧和无助。在这样的时刻，我们被呼召要记住每个人的尊严，并为公义与和平祷告。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Watch: Moment humanoid robot beats Usain Bolt's 100m record
title.zh: 见证时刻：人形机器人打破博尔特百米纪录

summary.en: A humanoid robot developed in Beijing has completed a 100m sprint in 9.39 seconds, surpassing Usain Bolt's world record of 9.58 seconds. The event, held at the World Humanoid Robot Games, showcased advancements in robotics including boxing, football, and household tasks. While the robot's speed is a mechanical...
summary.zh: 在北京举行的世界人形机器人运动会上，一台人形机器人以9.39秒的成绩完成了百米冲刺，超越了尤塞恩·博尔特9.58秒的世界纪录。此次活动展示了机器人在拳击、足球和家务处理等领域的进步。虽然机器人的速度是一个机械里程碑，但它也凸显了在模仿人类体能方面飞速的技术进步。

body.en:
A robot has outperformed humans by running faster than Usain Bolt's 100m sprint world record at the World Humanoid Robot Games in China.

The humanoid robot, developed by the Beijing Innovation Centre of Humanoid Robotics, ran the distance in 9.39 seconds at the event.

Eight-time Olympic gold medallist Bolt set the world record for humans in 2009, running 100m in 9.58 seconds.

The robot beat two others including one made by Chinese smartphone maker Honor - which the manufacturer says ran the distance in 9.32 seconds in a test run.

Other events at the robot games, which started on Saturday, include boxing and football, but also household tasks such as folding laundry.
body.zh: 在中国举行的世界人形机器人运动会上，机器人跑得比尤塞恩·博尔特 (Usain Bolt) 保持的 1 亿米短跑世界纪录还要快，从而超越了人类。 由北京仿人机器人创新中心研发的仿人机器人在比赛中跑出了9.39秒的成绩。 八届奥运会金牌得主博尔特在 2009 年以 9.58 秒跑完 100m 的成绩创造了人类世界纪录。 该机器人击败了另外两个机器人，其中包括中国智能手机制造商荣耀制造的一个机器人，该制造商表示，该机器人在测试运行中仅用了 9.32 秒就跑完了距离。 周六开始的机器人比赛的其他项目包括拳击和足球，还有叠衣服等家务活。

reflection.en: The sight of a machine clocking 9.39 seconds in Beijing challenges our understanding of physical limits and the 'prize' of athletic achievement. While a robot can be engineered for singular mechanical efficiency, the human race involves a holistic discipline of the soul and body that reflects the wisdom of Yahweh. We celebrate human ingenuity in creating...
reflection.zh: 在北京看到机器跑出9.39秒的成绩，挑战了我们对体能极限和竞技“奖赏”的理解。虽然机器人可以为了单一的机械效率而设计，但人类的赛程包含了反映雅伟智慧的身心全面操练。我们赞叹人类创造此类工具的智慧，但我们也记得，人的终极价值不在于成为最快的“机器”。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: After two decades, China is preparing its boldest Moon mission yet
title.zh: 历经二十载，中国正筹备迄今为止最大胆的探月任务

summary.en: China's ambitious space program will take it to the moon as soon as next month, and it's looking for water.
summary.zh: 中国雄心勃勃的航天计划最早将于下月开启探月之旅，重点是寻找月球上的水源。

body.en:
How do you explore a place where the sun never shines? China's space program will soon embark on one of the most innovative lunar exploration missions in recent years.

We’ve known for nearly two decades that some form of water exists on the moon. What we still don’t know is exactly how much accessible water ice lies inside permanently shadowed craters, how deeply it is buried or what form it takes.

What we do know is that accessing that water ice will be a real challenge: it is found at the bottom of deep, hard-to-traverse craters where the sun never shines, remaining untouched for billions of years at temperatures well below –200C. These are among the most valuable places on the moon, but the hardest to reach and explore.

Lunar exploration has come a long way since the Soviet Union’s Luna-1 probe reached the moon's vicinity in January 1959. The Apollo missions and their successors showed the challenge is no longer simply to reach the moon. It is to explore places human and conventional rovers cannot easily go, and ultimately determine whether the moon itself can provide some of the resources that future explorers will need.

China has spent two decades building an increasingly ambitious lunar exploration program, named after Chang'e, the ancient Chinese goddess of the moon. The Chang'e-7 mission is expected to set course for our celestial neighbour later this month, although a recent failure involving a different Chinese rocket has introduced some uncertainty over the launch date. Here’s what makes this latest mission so interesting.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The mission will test several novel approaches to lunar exploration. It will consist of an orbiter, a lander, a rover and a hopper.

In addition, the Queqiao-2 lunar relay satellite is already in place. Launched separately in March 2024, it subsequently supported the Chang'e-6 mission and will facilitate communication between Earth and the lunar surface during the Chang'e-7 mission.

We don’t know precisely where the mission will land, but a site on or near an illuminated ridge close to the Shackleton crater in the Lunar South Pole’s Aitken region is a prime candidate.

The hopper will be the mission’s real star. Unlike a wheeled rover, it’s designed to leap over broken terrain and descend into craters where sunlight never reaches, places conventional vehicles may simply be unable to enter.

Adding it to the mission makes sense, given the steep crater walls, broken terrain, permanent shadow and the need for autonomous navigation and communications.

Chinese scientists won’t be looking for signs of water; we...
body.zh: 如何探索一个阳光照不到的地方？中国的太空计划很快将启动近年来最具创新性的月球探测任务之一。 近二十年来，我们已经知道月球上存在某种形式的水。我们仍然不知道的是，在永久阴影的陨石坑内到底有多少可接近的水冰，它埋藏的深度有多深，或者它的形式是什么。 我们所知道的是，获取这些水冰将是一个真正的挑战：它是在难以穿越的深坑底部发现的，那里的阳光永远不会照射到，在远低于零下200摄氏度的温度下数十亿年都保持不变。这些是月球上最有价值的地方，但也是最难到达和探索的地方。 自 1959 年 1 月苏联的 Luna-1 探测器到达月球附近以来，月球探索已经取得了长足的进步。阿波罗任务及其后续任务表明，挑战不再仅仅是到达月球。它是为了探索人类和传统漫游车无法轻易到达的地方，并最终确定月球本身是否可以提供未来探险者所需的一些资源。 中国花了二十年的时间制定了一项日益雄心勃勃的月球探测计划，该计划以中国古代月亮女神嫦娥的名字命名。嫦娥七号任务预计将于本月晚些时候飞往我们的天体邻居，尽管最近另一枚中国火箭的失败给发射日期带来了一些不确定性。这就是这个最新任务如此有趣的原因。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 该任务将测试几种月球探索的新方法。它将由轨道飞行器、着陆器、漫游车和漏斗组成。 此外，鹊桥二号月球中继卫星也已就位。它于2024年3月单独发射，随后支持嫦娥六号任务，并将在嫦娥七号任务期间促进地球与月球表面之间的通信。 我们不知道任务将在哪里着陆，但月球南极艾特肯地区靠近沙克尔顿陨石坑的照明山脊上或附近的一个地点是主要候选地点。 漏斗将成为这次任务的真正明星。与轮式漫游车不同，它的设计目的是跳过破碎的地形并下降到阳光永远无法到达的陨石坑中，而传统车辆可能根本无法进入这些地方。 考虑到陡峭的火山口壁、破碎的地形、永久的阴影以及自主导航和通信的需求，将其添加到任务中是有意义的。 中国科学家不会寻找水的迹象；而是寻找水的迹象。我们...

reflection.en: The quest for water in the moon's permanently shadowed craters, where temperatures drop below -200C, reflects the persistent human drive to uncover the universe's hidden secrets. As researchers seek to understand what has remained untouched for billions of years, we see the dignity of the scientific pursuit. This mission reminds us that searching out the...
reflection.zh: 在温度低于零下200摄氏度、阳光永不照射的月球阴影坑中寻找水源，体现了人类揭开宇宙隐藏奥秘的持久动力。当研究人员试图了解数十亿年来未被触及的物质时，我们看到了科学探索的尊严。这次任务提醒我们，探索受造界的奥秘是一项崇高的事业，它致敬了雅伟所创造之世界的复杂性。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

body.en: Follow updates live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Angela Jackson, the commissioner of the Productivity Commission, said the body stands by the interim report into the GST, which found the deal with Western Australia to be a costly mistake that should be reversed. Jackson spoke to RN this morning after WA premier Roger Cook said “east coast clowns” didn’t understand the state and any changes would “rip $6bn out of the Western Australia economy”. We are aiming, of course, to inform public policy debate, which can often get heated. Our view is that a line was crossed in terms of the nature of those comments from the Western Australian premier last month. We welcome debate and we welcome criticism of our work and our report more broadly because it makes our work stronger. But to undermine and I guess attack our integrity, I think is an additional bridge too far. And I think something that more broadly we are seeing in public debate internationally. title.en: Northern Territory MP Luke Gosling steps down as defence envoy after assault charge
title.zh: 北领地议员卢克·高斯林在袭击指控后辞去国防特使职务

summary.en: Gosling says he "categorically denies" the charges against him and will defend himself in court.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A Labor politician in the Northern Territory has stood aside from an envoy role after he was charged by police for a second time.

Darwin-based Luke Gosling, who holds the federal seat of Solomon, is facing fresh accusations of breaching his bail conditions.

He was originally charged in July with the assault of Northern Territory Administrator David Connolly, the jurisdiction's equivalent to a state governor.

In a statement on Wednesday, Gosling announced his decision to step down until the matters have been dealt with in court.

"Due to the ongoing media attention and the distraction this is causing to the business of government, I have decided to temporarily stand aside as Special Envoy for Defence, Veterans' Affairs and Northern Australia," Gosling said in a post on social media.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I am more committed than ever to my role serving the people of Darwin and Palmerston."

Gosling vowed to "rigorously" defend himself against the charges in court and strongly denies the allegations.

Gosling was charged on Tuesday with one count of breach of bail and is due to appear in Darwin Local Court on 30 September.

Earlier on Wednesday, Opposition leader Angus Taylor said the prime minister faced an even "stronger test" of his leadership since charges were first laid.

"[Anthony Albanese] must act. It's completely unacceptable for a second charge to be placed on Luke Gosling. He should be stood down," he told ABC News Breakfast.

"Presumption of innocence is important in our system, but he should be stood down whilst these proceedings continue."

The assault is alleged to have occurred at the NT Thailand Grand Festival in Darwin on 18 July, with Gosling posting photos from the event on social media that day.

"You've gotta get punted, mate. I don't know, let's see what Mr Albanese does," he told News24.

NT Chief Minister Lia Finocchiaro said the matter was for Albanese to deal with.

"Ultimately, if all of these allegations are true, it clearly doesn't meet the expectation of our community," she told ABC radio.

Gosling's lawyer, Marty Aust, has previously criticised police for arresting the politician at his home rather than issuing him a summons or notice to appear.

As part of his bail conditions, Gosling is banned from going within 50 metres of the NT's Government House building and must give the administrator's office 48 hours' notice before attending any event where the two men would be present.

If they are at an event together, the Labor politician must not be within 15m of Connolly.

summary.en: Despite falling to its lowest level in eight months, inflation is still higher than consensus expectations.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Australia's headline inflation rate has come in above expectations despite falling to its lowest level in eight months.

The consumer price index rose 1 per cent in July, with the annual rate of inflation falling to   3.5   per cent, the Australian Bureau of Statistics reported on Wednesday.

Largely as a result of a decline in the growth of electricity prices, headline inflation was down from 3.8 per cent in the year to June and the lowest level since November.

Worryingly for the Reserve Bank, trimmed mean inflation — a measure of underlying inflation that strips out volatile items — held steady at 3.6 per cent, above expectations for a fall to 3.5 per cent.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Housing was the largest contributor to inflation, up 5 per cent, said ABS head of price statistics Rachael McCririck.

"New dwellings prices rose 5.7 per cent in the 12 months to July as builders passed on higher costs for materials and labour," she said.

Fuel prices rose 7.5 per cent in the month after falling for three months in a row.

"This was driven by higher world oil prices and the partial unwinding of the federal government's fuel excise relief measures in July," McCririck said.

Food and non-alcoholic beverages were also strong contributors in the month, rising 3.2 per cent, as well as recreation and culture, which rose 2.6 per cent.

Minutes from the RBA's August board meeting, released on Tuesday, showed the board was concerned about upside risks to inflation.

title.en: Should Australian travellers be worried? What 22 years of runway incidents reveal
title.zh: 澳大利亚跑道警示：22年数据揭示了什么

summary.en: Recent safety incidents at Sydney Airport, including four close calls within three weeks, have prompted a deep dive into 22 years of aviation data. Investigators are examining whether runway incursions and taxiing collisions are becoming more frequent at Australia's busiest transport hub.
summary.zh: 悉尼机场近期在三周内发生了四起险些相撞的事故，引发了对跑道安全的高度关注。调查人员正在分析过去22年的航空数据，以确定在澳大利亚最繁忙的交通枢纽，跑道入侵和滑行碰撞事故是否正变得更加频繁。

body.en:
Four close calls on Sydney Airport runways in as many weeks have put air traffic management in the spotlight.

It's too early to determine the exact cause of each one. But four ground-safety occurrences at Australia's busiest airport in a little over three weeks raise an obvious question: how common are occurrences like these, and are they becoming more frequent?

To examine the broader pattern, I analysed Australian Transport Safety Bureau data from 2003 to 2025 for Australian commercial air transport, focusing on runway incursions (the incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle or person in a protected runway area) and taxiing collisions or near collisions (an aircraft colliding or nearly colliding with another aircraft, person or object while taxiing).

The most recent incident occurred just after 8am last Tuesday, when two planes were given permission to use the same runway at the same time. Luckily, one plane stopped when its pilot saw the other plane.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A little over a week earlier, on 9 August, there were two more incidents in less than three hours.

At 7.20am, a Jetstar Airbus A320 preparing to depart for the Gold Coast encountered an empty Qatar Airways Boeing 777 being towed across a taxiway. Both planes stopped abruptly. One Jetstar cabin crew member sustained a serious injury.

Then, at about 10am, a Virgin Australia Boeing 737 bound for Perth began its take-off sequence on a runway as a Qantas 737 crossed another runway ahead. Both crews reported having received the relevant clearance from air traffic control. The Virgin crew stopped as air traffic control cancelled its take-off clearance.

On July 27, air traffic control cleared a Qantas Boeing 737 to cross a runway while a smaller plane was still landing. Air traffic control detected the issue and alerted both crews, with the 737 stopping after passing the holding point.

The Australian Transport Safety Bureau investigates and reports on safety incidents involving planes, helicopters, trains and boats. These incidents include those that happen during taxiing, takeoff and landing.

Raw counts of reported occurrences can be misleading because aviation activity has varied substantially, particularly during the COVID pandemic. More flying creates more risk. So I also calculated occurrence rates per million flight hours, for both domestic aviation and all commercial air transport, which includes domestic aviation as well as other forms of aviation such as freight and charter.

For domestic aviation, analysis of the annual data from 2003 to 2025 shows a significant increasing underlying trend in both the number and rate of taxiing collisions or...
body.zh: 数周内悉尼机场跑道发生四次险情，使空中交通管理成为人们关注的焦点。 现在确定每个问题的确切原因还为时过早。但在三周多的时间里，澳大利亚最繁忙的机场发生了四起地面安全事件，这引发了一个明显的问题：此类事件有多常见？它们是否会变得更加频繁？ 为了研究更广泛的模式，我分析了澳大利亚运输安全局 2003 年至 2025 年澳大利亚商业航空运输的数据，重点关注跑道侵入（飞机、车辆或人员错误地出现在受保护的跑道区域）和滑行碰撞或接近碰撞（一架飞机在滑行时与另一架飞机、人员或物体相撞或几乎相撞）。 最近一次事件发生在上周二上午 8 点刚过，当时两架飞机获准同时使用同一跑道。幸运的是，当一架飞机的飞行员看到另一架飞机时停了下来。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 一周多前的 8 月 9 日，不到三个小时又发生了两起事件。 上午 7 点 20 分，一架捷星空客 A320 飞机准备飞往黄金海岸，在滑行道上遇到一架空的卡塔尔航空波音 777 飞机。两架飞机都突然停了下来。捷星航空的一名机组人员受重伤。 然后，上午 10 点左右，一架飞往珀斯的维珍澳大利亚航空波音 737 飞机开始在跑道上起飞，而前面的一架澳洲航空 737 飞机也穿过了另一条跑道。两名机组人员报告称已获得空中交通管制的相关许可。由于空中交通管制取消了起飞许可，维珍机组人员停下来。 7 月 27 日，空中交通管制允许一架澳航波音 737 飞机穿越跑道，而另一架较小的飞机仍在着陆。空中交通管制发现了这一问题并向两名机组人员发出警报，737 在经过等待点后停下来。 澳大利亚运输安全局负责调查和报告涉及飞机、直升机、火车和船只的安全事件。这些事件包括滑行、起飞和着陆期间发生的事件。 报告事件的原始计数可能会产生误导，因为航空活动变化很大，特别是在新冠疫情期间。更多的飞行会带来更多的风险。因此，我还计算了国内航空和所有商业航空运输（包括国内航空以及货运和包机等其他形式的航空）每百万飞行小时的发生率。 对于国内航空而言，对 2003 年至 2025 年年度数据的分析表明，滑行碰撞的数量和发生率均呈显着增加的潜在趋势……

By analyzing decades of data, investigators seek to identify patterns of risk before they manifest as tragedy. Yahweh invites us to a similar prudence in our own lives, recognizing that 'close...

title.en: One boat, more than 400 people and 25 years of consequences
title.zh: 一艘船，400多人和25年的后果

summary.en: Twenty-five years after the Tampa affair, the people, policies, and political fault lines behind Australia's border debate remain.
summary.zh: 坦帕事件25年后，澳大利亚边境辩论背后的人物、政策和政治分歧依然存在。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

For Farid — a pseudonym used to protect his identity — those three words still carry him back 25 years, to a ship in the Indian Ocean, a teenage boy surrounded by hundreds of strangers, and the sudden arrival of Australian authorities after the vessel that had rescued him was prevented from reaching Christmas Island — an Australian territory.

He was 17. He had fled Afghanistan, leaving behind his single mother and siblings, and spent eight months moving from one boat to another in search of safety.

By the time the Norwegian freighter MV Tampa rescued him and 432 other asylum seekers — most of them Hazara Afghans — from a stricken fishing boat named the Palapa in August 2001, he had already endured storms, days at sea and the uncertainty of not knowing where the journey would end. At the time, Hazaras were fleeing Afghanistan, fearing persecution from the resurgent Taliban.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We weren't clearly told where they were going to take us. When we first saw the authorities' ship, I thought they were going to take us to Australia," Farid tells SBS News.

Instead, he was taken to Naoero (formerly known as Nauru), where he would spend years caught up in Australia's newly established offshore processing system before eventually returning to Afghanistan.

"It was like a camp. We get our turns, about once a month, to go out for a few hours," he says.

"For the first year we didn't get to go out at all. We were not very hopeful. It was just tents at first, but then they set up portable rooms," Farid says.

Today, he is 42 and lives in Melbourne's south-east, where he works as a painter after completing trade courses and an apprenticeship. He was granted asylum in Australia in 2012.

The ordinary life Farid has built in Australia is a long way from the journey that brought him here, one that began when he was a teenager fleeing Afghanistan and led him into the centre of the 'Tampa crisis' and Australia's emerging offshore processing system .

Twenty-five years on, his experience offers a human window into the events surrounding the Tampa and the policy that followed, known as the Pacific Solution, as Australia continues to debate how it responds to people seeking protection.

On 24 August 2001, the Palapa ran into trouble in rough seas about 140km north of Christmas Island, leaving those on board facing the prospect of sinking.

Two days later, on 26 August, Australia's Rescue Coordination Centre alerted ships in the area that the vessel was in distress, with the words "HELP" and "SOS" painted...
body.zh: 分享您的反馈并帮助我们改进此功能。请在此处详细了解我们如何在 SBS 使用人工智能。 对于法里德（Farid）——一个用来保护自己身份的化名——来说，这三个词仍然把他带回到 25 年前，印度洋上的一艘船上，一个十几岁的男孩被数百名陌生人包围，以及在营救他的船只无法到达澳大利亚领土圣诞岛后，澳大利亚当局突然赶到。 他当时 17 岁。他离开了阿富汗，留下了单亲母亲和兄弟姐妹，花了八个月的时间从一艘船搬到另一艘船以寻求安全。 2001 年 8 月，当挪威货船 MV Tampa 从一艘名为 Palapa 的失事渔船上救出他和其他 432 名寻求庇护者（其中大多数是哈扎拉阿富汗人）时，他已经经历了暴风雨、在海上漂泊的日子以及不知道旅程将在哪里结束的不确定性。当时，哈扎拉人因担心受到死灰复燃的塔利班的迫害而逃离阿富汗。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 法里德告诉 SBS 新闻：“我们没有明确告知他们要带我们去哪里。当我们第一次看到当局的船时，我以为他们会带我们去澳大利亚。” 相反，他被带到瑙鲁，在那里他在澳大利亚新建立的离岸加工系统中度过了数年，然后最终返回阿富汗。 “这就像一个营地。我们大约每月一次轮流出去几个小时，”他说。 “第一年，我们根本不能出去。我们没有太大希望。一开始只是帐篷，但后来他们设立了便携式房间，”法里德说。 如今，他 42 岁，住在墨尔本东南部，完成贸易课程和学徒期后，他在那里担任画家。 2012年，他在澳大利亚获得庇护。 法里德在澳大利亚建立的平凡生活与他来到这里的旅程相去甚远，他十几岁的时候就开始了逃离阿富汗的旅程，并带领他进入了“坦帕危机”和澳大利亚新兴离岸加工系统的中心。 二十五年过去了，他的经历为了解坦帕事件及其随后的政策（称为“太平洋解决方案”）提供了一个人性化的窗口，澳大利亚仍在争论如何应对寻求保护的人。 2001年8月24日，帕拉帕号在圣诞岛以北约140公里处的波涛汹涌的海面上遇到麻烦，船上的人面临沉没的危险。 两天后，即 8 月 26 日，澳大利亚救援协调中心向该地区的船只发出该船遇险的警报，并在船顶涂上了“HELP”和“SOS”字样。 最近的...

reflection.en: The story of Farid, who fled Afghanistan at 17 and found himself caught in Australia's border policies, echoes the long-term human impact of such decisions. For 25 years, the debate has continued, leaving individuals like Farid in prolonged uncertainty. The ancient call to welcome the foreigner, to treat the stranger as one of your own, remains a profound...
reflection.zh: 法里德的故事，他17岁时逃离阿富汗，却发现自己陷入澳大利亚的边境政策之中，这呼应了此类决定长期的个人影响。25年来，争论仍在继续，让像法里德这样的人长期处于不确定之中。古老的呼召——要欢迎外国人，待客如本地人——仍然是对那些在边境管制中挣扎的国家一个深刻的挑战。

title.en: Neo-Nazi Thomas Sewell has been talking about autism. Experts say he's recruiting
title.zh: 新纳粹分子托马斯·塞维尔谈论自闭症。专家称他正在招募

summary.en: Neo-Nazi Thomas Sewell has been recorded joking about 'recruiting' autistic men and discussing how to channel their 'fixations.' Experts warn this is a tactic to recruit vulnerable individuals into extremist movements.
summary.zh: 新纳粹分子托马斯·塞维尔被录下视频，他开玩笑地谈论“招募”自闭症男性并讨论如何引导他们的“执念”。专家警告说，这是将弱势个体招募到极端主义运动中的一种策略。

body.en:
Watch the full documentary 'Autism, Extremism and Recruitment' on our YouTube channel.

"Adolf Hitler, huge autist, massive autist, like all these incredible men, some of the best men that ever lived," Thomas Sewell tells viewers online.

Sewell, a neo-Nazi who led the National Socialist Network (NSN), now White Australia, is 10 minutes into a 22-minute monologue giving his "take" on autism.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We used to bully nerds and now we coddle them. Now we're like, 'Oh, you have a disability. You're autistic.' And we treat them like that they're f---ing retarded."

Sewell repeatedly returns to the idea that autistic men do not need to be treated differently, but instead need challenge, male role models and to ‘channel their fixations’. He suggests joining the military — Sewell is ex-Army himself — learning a trade or pursuing higher education.

Sewell dismisses expert understanding of autism repeatedly in his videos — "none of these experts understand autism" — and argues instead that those who struggle have not had "the right mentoring from the right male role models".

Running through his commentary is Sewell’s own movement. Sewell claims that at one point about one-fifth of NSN members were autistic and tells viewers about one former NSN member he says he took under his wing.

"I became like his big brother, and I taught him how to lift [weights], and I taught him how to fight and I taught him how to talk to girls and after two years of just intense bullying … he became like a normal person."

A year later, in 2025, Sewell shared another video speaking about autism. This time as he criticised a Countering Violent Extremism program.

"I've recruited hundreds of autistic teenagers and zero of them have stabbed anyone," Sewell jokes.

We contacted Sewell and he denied that he ever actively recruited autistic people.

But his comments come as the Australian Federal Police (AFP) and researchers stress that extremist groups target young people, who they see as vulnerable, including those who are neurodivergent.

Peta Lowe, who spent years leading the NSW government’s Countering Violent Extremism program for young people, has no doubts about the video.

"It is a recruitment video. Whether he frames it that way for himself or not," she tells The Feed.

"For a lot of neurodivergent people, one of the things they really struggle with is social interactions and understanding what people mean and the various layers of communication," she says.

title.en: 'You can't escape': A growing fight over what belongs in Australia's suburbs
title.zh: 肖恩想在这里抚养儿子，直到那个“巨大的黑匣子”出现

summary.en: Residents in West Footscray, Melbourne, are reporting significant disruptions from a newly constructed NextDC data center located 300 meters from residential homes. The facility brings constant humming noise and light pollution, leading to calls for better planning protections for existing communities.
summary.zh: 墨尔本西富茨克雷的居民反映，距离住宅区仅300米的新建 NextDC 数据中心造成了严重干扰。该设施带来了持续的嗡嗡声和光污染，引发了人们呼吁为现有社区提供更好的规划保护。

body.en:
When Sean Brown moved to West Footscray two years ago, days after his son was born, he thought he'd found a good spot to raise a family — green space, a train station nearby, and a community with room to grow.

Instead, his home is now 300 metres from one of the largest data centres in the country.

"It's a massive black box in the middle of a residential area. There's this visual heaviness to it that you can't really escape," Brown told SBS News.

NextDC's M3 facility in the Melbourne suburb brings a constant humming noise audible even 100m away, he said, while ongoing construction means near-constant light, noise and disruption.

Parking is scarce with facility workers competing for street spots, and Brown said whole streets have lost power for full days at a time during infrastructure works, with little warning and no compensation. He's also worried about health risks, and the future of his entire suburb.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Branded by its chief executive, Craig Scroggie, as "Australia's largest hyperscale AI factory", the M3 site is set to double in size by 2027 — covering 10 hectares in size, and drawing 225MW of power, 24 hours a day.

A separate facility, the Perri Melbourne Data Centre (PMDC), has been approved and planned just a few blocks over.

There are currently 162 operational data centres across Australia, with a further 90 proposed, according to the Climate Council — and it's unclear whether planned rules to data centres in residential areas will apply to any of them.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese used a speech to the Business Council of Australia's annual dinner on Tuesday night to announce new national rules that would block future data centres from being built near homes, schools, or prime agricultural land.

Developers will also be required to add more renewable energy to the grid than their data centres consume, minimise water use, and ensure new sites are appropriate for their size — avoiding land that could otherwise be used for housing.

"Australia is in a strong position to attract investment in data centres, but maintaining social licence will be essential," Albanese said.

"That means ensuring energy bills do not rise, water security is maintained and locations are appropriate."

Asked about communities already living with data centres, Albanese did not directly answer when pressed on ABC Perth on Tuesday, instead pointing to the same social licence framework.

Asked by SBS News whether any measures would target existing sites or address community concern that the new rules don't cover people already affected, the prime minister's office declined to comment.

title.en: 'Extraordinarily expensive': Is this Australia's most controversial construction project?
title.zh: “极其昂贵”的项目正在重塑一个州——并划定政治战线

summary.en: Victoria's Premier Ben Carroll has announced a $2 billion reduction in the cost of the state's largest infrastructure project, the Suburban Rail Loop. This pivot comes amid ongoing debate over the project's "extraordinarily expensive" nature, its disputed economic benefits, and its lengthy construction timeline.
summary.zh: 维多利亚州州长本·卡罗尔宣布，将该州最大的基础设施项目——城郊铁路环线（SRL）的成本削减20亿澳元。这一调整是在该项目“极其昂贵”、经济效益存在争议以及建设周期漫长等问题持续引发辩论之际做出的。

body.en:
Few infrastructure projects have generated as much debate as Victoria's Suburban Rail Loop.

The 90km rail project promises to reshape how Melbourne grows and moves, but its cost, benefits and delivery timeline have been fiercely contested.

That debate has again been thrust into the spotlight after Premier Ben Carroll announced $2 billion in cuts to the project this week, declaring: "I respect your money."

Supporters say the rail loop is a once-in-a-generation investment that will help accommodate Melbourne's growth. But critics argue it comes with an eye-watering price tag and uncertain returns, helping make it one of Australia's most controversial infrastructure projects.

Liam Davies, a lecturer in sustainability and urban planning at RMIT University, said the SRL was a step towards transforming Melbourne's city-centric public transport system into an interconnected network.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Melbourne's greatest challenge is that it has become an extraordinarily large city, physically," he told SBS News.

"We can't just adopt the transport strategy for a denser, more compact city like London. We need to do something of our own, and the SRL is an attempt to do that in a Melburnian context."

With Labor and the Coalition deeply divided on the SRL, the project's future could be decided when Victorians head to the polls in November.

The SRL will connect Melbourne's middle suburbs from Cheltenham in the south-east to Werribee in the west via Melbourne Airport through a 90km underground rail line.

The project is split into three stages. The first section — SRL East — is under construction, running from Cheltenham to Box Hill via six new underground stations. The first trains are expected by 2035.

Critics argue the mega-project's business case doesn't stack up, and the multi-billion-dollar price tag is a financial liability for Victoria, which has the second-highest debt per capita of any state or territory, behind the Northern Territory.

More than $33 billion has already been invested in SRL East, according to the premier.

A Parliamentary Budget Office analysis puts the price tag for building the East and North sections at $96.4 billion, though there is currently no fully costed estimate for the entire project, which includes the final stage, SRL West.

An evaluation last year by Infrastructure Australia — an advisory body to the federal government — found the SRL's business case was insufficiently detailed and relied on future stages to justify its benefits.

It also urged the Victorian government to develop "exit strategies" should the project be unable to be completed.

Allegations of corruption...

title.en: 'Get it out': ARIA to ban AI-generated music from Australian charts
title.zh: “Get it out”：ARIA 将禁止人工智能生成的音乐出现在澳大利亚排行榜上

summary.en: ARIA says that songs must be "substantially human-made" to qualify for a spot on its long-running music charts.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Music will need to be "substantially human-made" in order to qualify for Australia's main music chart, in an industry bid to stamp out AI-generated tracks.

Songs wholly generated using artificial intelligence will no longer be eligible for the ARIA charts from Friday, in an update to The Australian Recording Industry Association's (ARIA) code of practice.

ARIA chief executive Annabelle Herd said a chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would "undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to present".

"The ARIA charts are about tracking consumption and sales of music in Australia, but they're also about celebrating human artistry and success," Herd told ABC radio.

"We're not particularly interested in including AI-generated music as part of that process, particularly when it's taking up a spot from an Australian artist in the chart."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

AI-assisted songs will still feature on the charts, but they must be substantially human-made and raise no stream or chart manipulation concerns.

"I'm sure that there are a lot of artists that are using AI tools to enhance creativity, to do really cool, new, exciting things," Herd said.

"Artists have always been at the forefront of new tech ... it's made some of the best music ever created, and no doubt AI will create some really exciting evolution of that."

Songs on the ARIA charts that use AI include Gold Coast-based DJ and producer Josh Fawaz's dance track Like a Prayer, which is fourth on the ARIA's top 20 Australian singles after peaking at number two in May.

A dance cover of Madonna's 1989 hit, generative AI is credited for the drums and vocals on the track, according to Spotify.

Australian electronic band Peking Duk supported the association's call to outlaw generative AI from the charts, claiming it was "removing the human experience from life".

"AI is using our stuff. It's using a lot of our peers' stuff, you know, people we know," band member Adam Hyde told Channel Nine's Today show .

"There is so much good art in Australia and something like AI coming along and kind of sweeping the charts and all that jazz, it's like, get it out."

ARIA's decision heeds global AI principles drawn up by the record industry's peak body, The International Federation of the Phonographic Industry, in July.

The federation said the guidelines would be rolled out to official charts in Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia and advocated to more than 20 other official chart programs in Europe and the Pacific, including the ARIAs.

title.en: 'Curriculum changes can boost student STEM numbers'
title.zh: 课程改革可望增加STEM学生人数

summary.en: An education sector representative believes that the government's planned enhancements to the senior secondary science and extended mathematics curriculum will lead to more students enrolling in these subjects. The Education Bureau is reviewing curriculum content and assessment for these subjects, intending to divide...
summary.zh: 一位教育界代表认为，政府对高中科学和延伸数学课程的改进计划将鼓励更多学生选修这些科目。教育局正在审议这些科目的课程内容和评估安排，并计划将内容分为核心和延伸部分，以适应不同能力和学习需求的学生，旨在提升学生的创新和科技能力。

body.en: The government’s efforts to enhance the senior secondary science and extended mathematics curriculum will encourage more students to take the subjects, according to an education sector representative. This came after the Education Bureau announced the enhancement measures in a circular to schools, saying it aims to strengthen science, technology and maths education (STEM) to improve students’ innovation and technology capabilities. The bureau said it is reviewing the curriculum content and assessment arrangements for senior secondary science subjects and extended maths. It plans on dividing the content into core and extended parts to cater to students with different abilities and study needs. It also called on schools to encourage students with interests or potential in science to take two or more science and mathematics subjects at the senior secondary level. Speaking at a RTHK radio programme, Ho Wai-lung, chairman of the Mathematics Committee of the Hong Kong Association for Science and Mathematics Education, said the measures would encourage students take science subjects. “The Education Bureau wants students to know that if they are interested in science, wish to continue to study science and mathematics subjects in university and conduct further studies, it’s important to learn from a young age,” he said. But Ho said some schools might face challenges in manpower, adding that teachers may need to go through further education to align with the policy. He also dismissed concerns that the focus on maths and science education would hinder students’ all-round development, saying pupils could still choose their subjects freely. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 一位教育部门代表表示，政府加强高中科学和扩展数学课程的努力将鼓励更多学生学习这些科目。此前，教育局向学校发出通知，宣布加强措施，称旨在加强科学、技术和数学教育（STEM），以提高学生的创新和科技能力。该局表示，正在检讨高中科学科目和扩展数学的课程内容和评估安排。它计划将内容分为核心部分和扩展部分，以满足不同能力和学习需求的学生。它还呼吁学校鼓励对科学感兴趣或有潜力的学生在高中阶段选修两门或更多科学和数学科目。香港科学及数学教育协会数学委员会主席何伟龙在香港电台节目中表示，这些措施将鼓励学生选修科学科目。他说：“教育局希望学生知道，如果他们对科学感兴趣，希望在大学继续学习科学和数学科目并继续深造，从小学习很重要。”但何表示，一些学校可能面临人力方面的挑战，并补充说，教师可能需要接受进一步的教育才能与政策保持一致。他还驳斥了人们对数学和科学教育的关注会阻碍学生全面发展的担忧，称学生仍然可以自由选择科目。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The Hong Kong Education Bureau's focus on enhancing STEM curricula reflects a desire to equip the next generation with critical skills for the future. Proverbs 22:6 reminds us that the way we train our children profoundly shapes their path. May these curriculum changes foster not only technical proficiency but also wisdom and a commitment to using knowledge...
reflection.zh: 香港教育局着力于改进STEM课程，这体现了为下一代装备未来所需关键技能的愿望。《箴言》22:6提醒我们，我们教导孩子的方式会深刻地塑造他们的道路。愿这些课程改革不仅能培养技术能力，更能促进智慧和运用知识造福他人的决心。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

The 57-year-old told arresting officers the offence was “a momentary...

Micah 6:8 calls us to "act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God." This principle underscores the importance of ethical conduct and respect for others, especially for those...

The private residential rental index by the Rating and Valuation Department had surged by 18.5 per cent as of June to 205.8 from the Covid-19 pandemic trough in January 2023, which was 173.6, marking the first sustained breach of the 200 threshold. “Hong Kong’s...
body.zh: 房地产咨询公司仲量联行(JLL)表示，香港越来越多的外籍人士正在推动该市的住宅房地产租赁市场，豪宅租金今年可能上涨约5%，并在2027年继续上涨。差饷物业估价署的私人住宅租金指数截至6月已飙升18.5%至205.8，较2023年1月Covid-19大流行的低谷（173.6）飙升，首次持续突破200的门槛。 “香港的...

reflection.en: As Hong Kong's luxury markets climb to new heights, it is easy to focus solely on the shifting numbers of the rental index. Yet, these cycles of prosperity remind us that the ability to build and sustain such a vibrant economy is a gift to be used with gratitude and wisdom. We are called to remember that true stability is found not in the temporary upswing...
reflection.zh: 随着香港豪宅市场攀升至新高，人们很容易只关注租赁指数的变化。然而，这些繁荣的周期提醒我们，建立和维持如此充满活力的经济的能力是一份应当心怀感激和智慧去使用的礼物。我们受召要记住，真正的稳定不在于市场暂时的“上升期”，而在于那位赐予我们劳碌力量的雅伟。

This analysis follows the awarding of the first pilot area in Hung Shui...

Pledging an investment of HK$16.8 billion (US$2.14 billion), the consortium...

title.en: More space needed for HK's talent drive: HKU chief
title.zh: 香港大学校长：香港人才发展需要更多空间

summary.en: Hong Kong has the talent, but it needs to tackle challenges such as cutting red tape and expanding lab space to fully align with the education goals of the nation’s 15th Five-Year Plan, according to the president of the University of Hong Kong (HKU).
summary.zh: 香港大学校长表示，香港拥有人才，但需要解决精简行政程序和扩大实验室空间等挑战，才能完全符合国家“十四五”规划的教育目标。

body.en: Hong Kong has the talent, but it needs to tackle challenges such as cutting red tape and expanding lab space to fully align with the education goals of the nation’s 15th Five-Year Plan, according to the president of the University of Hong Kong (HKU). In an interview with RTHK's "Vision 15: Hong Kong's Chapter", Xiang Zhang laid out a clear roadmap for the city to become China's global education powerhouse — one that requires streamlining its administrative machinery and expanding university campuses. "We have all the attributes that we can recruit the top people," Zhang said, pointing to HKU's ranking as the world's most internationalised university. "Those top scholars, not only do you have to provide the excellent hardware, meaning equipment, laboratory conditions, but also the soft side, that means your administrative environment... your intellectual environment has to be very stimulating. "To do business in terms of buying equipment, reimbursing your travels, and so on, has to be simple and streamlined. So for that, I do think Hong Kong needs to revamp ourselves and modernise." Zhang also highlighted the need to find more space. With HKU only one-sixth the size of Tsinghua University in Beijing, he welcomed the initiative to build a new Northern Metropolis campus as a long-term fix. In the meantime, HKU is already in the midst of a massive expansion — constructing 20 new buildings, half of which will be dedicated to student housing, with completion targeted within three years. Zhang believes that would help to attract more non-local students. "I believe our student quota, both for non-local undergrad student and also PhD quota, can be further considered to expand a little bit. If you look at any top university, there are non-local students more than half," he said. Ultimately, Zhang envisions HKU becoming "China’s world classroom" by recruiting top scholars and students from around the world. On curriculum, he is steering HKU away from traditional professional silos towards interdisciplinary learning — launching degrees that merge science and the arts. "I think with AI, that automation [will] almost penetrate every profession, so we have to educate our students into multi-facet disciplines. "That is a huge contrast compared with our previous approach where we educate our students into a profession, whether you become a lawyer or become a medical doctor or engineer. "In the future, students may change their jobs every five years or every few years, so that can be a norm. Our students have to be able to have the knowledge broad enough to deal with such a complex world." body.zh: 香港大学校长表示，香港拥有人才，但需要解决诸如减少繁文缛节和扩大实验室空间等挑战，以完全符合国家第十五个五年计划的教育目标。在接受香港电台“愿景15：香港分会”采访时，张翔为香港成为中国的全球教育强国制定了清晰的路线图——需要精简行政机构并扩大大学校园。张说：“我们具备招募顶尖人才的所有条件。”他指的是香港大学被评为世界上最国际化的大学。 “那些顶尖学者，不仅要提供优良的硬件，就是设备、实验室条件，还要提供软性的，就是你的行政环境……你的智力环境要非常刺激。”做生意，买设备、报销路费等等，一定要简单、流程化。为此，我确实认为香港需要自我改造和现代化。”张还强调需要寻找更多的空间。由于香港大学的规模只有北京清华大学的六分之一，他对建设北都新校区作为长期解决方案表示欢迎。与此同时，香港大学已经在进行大规模扩建——建造20栋新建筑，其中一半将专门用于学生宿舍，目标是在三年内完工。张认为这将有助于吸引“我相信我们的学生名额，无论是非本地本科生还是博士生名额，都可以考虑进一步扩大一点。如果你看看任何一所顶尖大学，其中非本地学生超过一半。”他说。最终，张希望通过招收来自世界各地的顶尖学者和学生，使香港大学成为“中国的世界课堂”。在课程方面，他正在引导香港大学摆脱传统的专业筒仓，转向跨学科学习，推出融合科学和艺术的学位。“我认为，随着人工智能的发展，自动化将几乎渗透到每个职业，因此我们必须教育我们的学生进入多方面的学科。 “这与我们之前教育学生进入职业的方法形成了巨大的反差，无论你成为一名律师还是成为一名医生或工程师。”“未来，学生可能每五年或每隔几年更换工作，因此这可能成为一种常态。”我们的学生必须具备足够广泛的知识来应对如此复杂的世界。”但张也与全球热衷于纯科技教育的观点不同，他认为人文学科对学生也至关重要。“创造力从何而来？那是...

reflection.en: The University of Hong Kong president's call for cutting red tape and expanding lab space highlights the practical wisdom needed for a society to flourish. Just as a people needs guidance to achieve its potential, Hong Kong's ambition to become a global education powerhouse requires clear, actionable counsel. This reminds us that strategic planning and...
reflection.zh: 香港大学校长呼吁精简行政程序和扩大实验室空间，这突显了一个社会要蓬勃发展所需的实际智慧。正如一个民族需要指引才能发挥其潜力一样，香港要成为全球教育强国的抱负也需要清晰可行的建议。这提醒我们，战略规划和排除障碍对于集体进步和人才培养至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.zh: 香港法院宣判一名政府统计师无罪，他曾在学校开放日跟踪并拍摄一名女孩

summary.en: A Hong Kong magistrate acquitted a government statistician of a loitering offence, despite describing his behavior of following and photographing a schoolgirl during a school open day last year as “highly suspicious.” The Secondary 4 student identified as "X" had expressed concerns about her safety.
summary.zh: 香港一名裁判官宣判一名政府统计师游荡罪名不成立，尽管裁判官形容他去年在学校开放日跟踪并拍摄一名女学生的行为“高度可疑”。法庭上被确认为“X”的中四学生曾表示对自身安全感到担忧。

body.en: A Hong Kong magistrate has acquitted a government statistician of a loitering offence, despite describing his behaviour of following and photographing a schoolgirl during an open day last year as “highly suspicious.” Eastern Magistrates’ Courts. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. Patrick Lam, a statistician with the Census and Statistics Department, was cleared of a charge of “loitering causing concern” at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday. He allegedly caused a Secondary 4 student identified in court as “X” to have concerns about her safety during an open day at her school in Causeway Bay on July 5 last year. Magistrate Kestrel Lam said X’s concerns stemmed not from what happened on the open day, but from her experiences of being stalked by the defendant over the past two years. Those incidents, however, were not part of the offence details presented by the prosecution. According to local media, the court previously heard that the defendant began following X as early as October 2022. This included waiting for her at Olympic MTR station and initiating a conversation on at least one occasion, asking her whether she had an exam that day. The girl testified via video link earlier this month, saying that she had sought to avoid the defendant on her way to school but had still seen him at Central MTR station, apparently waiting for her. Following his arrest, the man admitted to police that he had followed the girl. Under caution, he said, “I followed the female student because she reminded me of an old friend, so I wanted to get to know her,” the court heard. Anti-stalking law Magistrate Lam said on Tuesday that the girl’s fear was rooted in her past encounters with the defendant rather than his behaviour during the open day. The loitering offence targets “objectively threatening behaviour,” the magistrate noted, adding that the court should not consider the defendant’s past conduct in the present case. Olympic Station. File photo: Wikicommons. The court must decide whether a normal student without X’s experience would have felt threatened by the defendant during the open day, the magistrate said, before ruling him not guilty. But the defendant’s behaviour, including secretly photographing the girl during the open day, was “undeniably highly suspicious,” the magistrate said. He noted that the Law Reform Commission (LRC) of Hong Kong has recommended the introduction of an anti-stalking law, and that the girl may seek assistance through other legal means. The LRC made the recommendation in a report released in October 2000. The government launched a public consultation regarding an anti-stalking law in 2011, but a legislative bid was dropped in 2014 due to a lack of consensus.
body.zh: 一名香港地方法官宣布一名政府统计员的游荡罪无罪，尽管他称这名统计员去年在开放日期间跟踪并拍摄一名女学生的行为“高度可疑”。东部裁判法院。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。周二，政府统计处统计员林伟强在东区裁判法院被洗清“游荡引起关注”罪名。据称，去年7月5日，他在铜锣湾学校的开放日期间，导致一名在法庭上被称为“X”的中四学生担心自己的安全。裁判官林凯斯特表示，X的担忧并非源于开放日发生的事情，而是源于她过去两年被被告跟踪的经历。然而，这些事件并不属于检方提出的犯罪细节的一部分。据当地媒体报道，法庭此前获悉，被告早在2022年10月就开始关注X，包括在奥运地铁站等她，并至少有一次主动对话，询问她当天是否有考试。该女孩本月早些时候通过视频连线作证，称她在上学途中试图避开被告，但仍然在中环地铁站看到他，显然正在等她。被捕后，该男子向警方承认他跟踪了该女孩。在谨慎的情况下，他说：“我跟踪这名女学生是因为她让我想起了一位老朋友，所以我想认识她，”法庭获悉。反跟踪法裁判官林周二表示，女孩的恐惧源于她过去与被告的遭遇，而不是他在开放日的行为。治安法官指出，游荡罪针对的是“客观威胁行为”，并补充说，法院不应在本案中考虑被告过去的行为。奥运站。资料照片：维基共享资源。治安法官表示，法院必须先确定一名没有 X 经历的普通学生在开放日期间是否会感受到被告的威胁，然后再裁定他无罪。但法官表示，被告的行为，包括在开放日偷偷拍摄女孩的照片，“无疑是高度可疑的”。他表示，香港法律改革委员会已建议制定反跟踪法，女孩可通过其他法律途径寻求协助。法改会在2000年10月发布的一份报告中提出了这一建议。政府于2011年就《反缠扰行为法》展开公众咨询，但由于缺乏共识而于2014年放弃了立法提案。

reflection.en: The magistrate's description of the statistician's actions as "highly suspicious," despite the acquittal, underscores the profound responsibility adults bear for the safety and well-being of children. Yahweh's word warns against causing harm or fear to "these little ones," reminding us that actions that make a child feel unsafe carry significant moral...
reflection.zh: 尽管该统计师被判无罪，裁判官对其行为“高度可疑”的描述，仍强调了成年人对儿童安全和福祉所负的深重责任。雅伟的话语告诫我们不要伤害或使“这些小孩子”感到恐惧，提醒我们，即使没有法律上的定罪，任何让孩子感到不安全的行为都具有重要的道德分量。铜锣湾发生的这起事件呼吁我们成为年轻人的警惕保护者，确保像学生“X”这样的孩子能在没有恐惧的环境中成长。

verse.textEn: If anyone causes one of these little ones — those who believe in me — to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
verse.textZh: 凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，沉在深海里。
verse.themeEn: Woe to those who harm children

title.en: Cabbie killed in North Lantau collision
title.zh: 北大屿山三车相撞 计程车司机伤重不治

summary.en: A taxi driver was killed in a three-vehicle collision in North Lantau on Tuesday evening. At least nine others were injured in the crash on Cheung Tung Road, which involved a taxi, a Discovery Bay bus, and a truck. The taxi driver was trapped and later pronounced dead at the hospital, while the injured included a taxi...
summary.zh: 周二晚间，北大屿山翔东路发生涉及计程车、大屿山巴士及货车的三车相撞事故，导致一名计程车司机死亡，另有九人受伤。该司机一度被困车内，送院后证实不治；伤者包括一名计程车乘客及八名巴士乘客。

body.en: A taxi driver was killed in a three-vehicle collision in North Lantau on Tuesday evening. At least nine others were injured in the crash on Cheung Tung Road at around 8pm. The collision involved a taxi, a single-decker Discovery Bay bus and a truck. Police said the taxi driver was trapped inside the vehicle before he was freed by emergency staff and rushed to the North Lantau Hospital where he was pronounced dead. A taxi passenger and eight people on the bus were injured. The Transport Department said all lanes of Cheung Tung Road near Sunny Bay, as well as the airport-bound slow lane of the North Lantau Highway, were closed for traffic because of the accident. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 周二晚上，一名出租车司机在北大屿山发生三车相撞事故中丧生。晚上8时左右，翔东路发生车祸，造成至少9人受伤。事故涉及一辆的士、一辆愉景湾单层巴士及一辆卡车。警方表示，出租车司机被困在车内，随后被急救人员救出并送往北大屿山医院，在那里他被宣布死亡。一名出租车乘客和巴士上的八人受伤。运输署表示，翔东路近欣澳的所有行车线，以及北大屿山公路往机场方向的慢车线，因事故而封闭。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The suddenness of the crash on Cheung Tung Road serves as a sobering reminder of how quickly a routine evening can turn into a scene of tragedy. As we mourn the loss of the taxi driver and pray for the recovery of the nine injured passengers, we lean on the promise of a day when such sorrow and death will be no more. In the face of such fragility, we find...
reflection.zh: 发生在翔东路的这场突发车祸清醒地提醒着我们，一个平凡的夜晚竟会如此迅速地演变成悲剧。在我们哀悼这位计程车司机的离世，并为九名受伤乘客的康复祈祷时，我们仰望那不再有悲哀和死亡的应许。面对生命的脆弱，我们在那数算每一滴哀恸之泪的雅伟面前寻得盼望。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Crunch culture and tight timelines blamed for 15 construction site deaths this year
title.zh: 今年香港建筑工地因“紧迫文化”和严格工期导致15人死亡

summary.en: Construction industry representatives in Hong Kong have attributed 15 fatal worksite accidents this year to a pervasive "crunch culture" and tight timelines. Union chair Chau Sze-kit explained that this environment pushes management to prioritize speed and convenience, leading to shortcuts on safety procedures to meet...
summary.zh: 香港建筑业代表将今年发生的15起致命工地事故归咎于普遍存在的“紧迫文化”和严格的工期。工会主席周思杰解释说，这种环境促使管理层优先考虑速度和便利，为了赶工期和避免罚款，从而在安全程序上走捷径。

body.en: Construction sector representatives have blamed the industry’s crunch culture for the 15 fatal worksite accidents recorded in Hong Kong since the beginning of this year. Construction workers in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Speaking on RTHK radio, Hong Kong Construction Industry Employees General Union chair Chau Sze-kit said that aloof attitudes toward occupational safety stem from a pervasive culture of rushing work at construction sites, pushing workers to prioritise convenience and foregoing precautions. “When frontline management faces deadlines and potential penalties, they may choose to take shortcuts on certain safety procedures,” Chau said in Cantonese. Chau also said the industry-wide practice of awarding contracts to the lowest bidder meant safety was sacrificed for speed, adding that contractors may offload the pressure they face to subcontractors who have “no bargaining power.” Speaking on the same RTHK programme, Lawrence Ng, chair of the Construction Workers Registration Board at the Construction Industry Council, said that worksite bosses are often pressed to get more done in less time to compensate for increasingly frequent delays caused by extreme weather. A worker at a construction site in Hong Kong on February 13, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. He cited a survey conducted by the Council indicating that 5 to 7 per cent of frontline managers and workers have “extremely weak” safety awareness. Safety culture Ng’s remarks come a day after Construction Industry Council chairperson Thomas Ho said during a construction safety event that worksite fatalities are continuing to climb in spite of harsher penalties levied against negligent employers. In April 2023, Hong Kong amended the Occupational Safety and Occupational Health Legislation Ordinance , raising the maximum penalty for employers who commit serious safety violations from HK$500,000 to HK$10 million. Violators also face up to two years in prison. Ho said the 15 deaths so far this year was an increase compared to before the penalty was raised. “Safety culture hasn’t made its way to the worksite,” Ho said in Cantonese. “Out of the 15 [fatalities]… even a safety supervisor died. Why? Because we have only paid lip service and haven’t truly fulfilled our responsibility.” Construction workers in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Crunch culture is one of the biggest killers on construction sites,” he added. Delivering an address at the same event, Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said that worksite accidents more broadly had decreased by 20 per cent between 2023 and 2025, following the implementation of the “4S” Smart Site Safety System. This enables early identification of potential safety hazards through smart devices and communication networks for...
body.zh: 建筑业代表将今年年初以来香港发生的 15 起工地致命事故归咎于该行业的加班文化。香港的建筑工人。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港建造业总工会主席周士杰在香港电台发表讲话时表示，对职业安全的冷漠态度源于建筑工地普遍存在的赶工文化，促使工人优先考虑方便而忽视预防措施。 “当一线管理层面临最后期限和潜在的处罚时，他们可能会选择在某些安全程序上走捷径，”周用粤语说。周还表示，全行业将合同授予最低投标人的做法意味着为了速度而牺牲安全，并补充说承包商可能会将他们面临的压力转嫁给“没有讨价还价能力”的分包商。建造业议会建造业工人注册管理局主席吴遵义在香港电台同一节目中表示，工地老板经常被迫在更短的时间内完成更多工作，以弥补极端天气造成的日益频繁的延误。 2023 年 2 月 13 日，香港建筑工地的一名工人。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。他援引该委员会进行的一项调查显示，5％至7％的一线管理人员和工人的安全意识“极薄弱”。安全文化 吴恩达发表上述言论的前一天，建造业议会主席托马斯·何（Thomas Ho）在一次建筑安全活动中表示，尽管对疏忽的雇主处以更严厉的处罚，但工地死亡人数仍在继续攀升。 2023年4月，香港修订《职业安全及职业健康法例条例》，将严重违反安全规定的雇主的最高罚款由50万港元提高至1,000万港元。违法者还将面临最高两年的监禁。何说，今年迄今为止的15人死亡人数比提高处罚前有所增加。 “安全文化还没有深入到工地，”何先生用粤语说道。 “15人（死亡）中……连一名安全主管都死了。为什么？因为我们只是说说而已，并没有真正履行我们的责任。”香港的建筑工人。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “紧缩文化是建筑工地最大的杀手之一，”他补充道。发展局局长伯纳黛特·林恩 (Bernadette Linn) 在同一活动中发表讲话时表示，在实施“4S”智能工地安全系统后，2023 年至 2025 年间，工地事故总体减少了 20%。这使得能够通过智能设备和通信网络及早识别潜在的安全隐患......

reflection.en: The tragic loss of 15 lives in Hong Kong's construction sector this year, attributed to a "crunch culture" that prioritizes deadlines over safety, reminds us of the profound dangers when financial pressures overshadow human well-being. Yahweh's word warns that the love of money can be a root of all kinds of evil, and here we see its devastating impact on...
reflection.zh: 今年香港建筑业因“紧迫文化”而导致15人丧生，这提醒我们，当经济压力凌驾于人的福祉之上时，会带来多么深重的危险。雅伟的话语警告我们，贪财是万恶之根，在此我们看到它对被迫放弃预防措施的工人造成了毁灭性的影响。这种情况呼吁我们重新评估行业惯例，确保没有人为了速度或利润而牺牲生命。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家之一的狱中手稿

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...
reflection.zh: 邹幸彤等活动家在囚禁中仍坚定不移地发出真理之声，这提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为弱势群体发声。雅伟的话语鼓励我们为那些不能为自己说话的人，特别是贫困和权利被剥夺的人，开口辩护。她在狱中的文字体现了对正义和自由的深刻承诺，即使为此付出个人代价。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。
