title.en: Reusable stencils create clean carbon nanotube patterns in single-stage process
title.zh: 可重复使用的模板在单阶段工艺中创建清洁的碳纳米管图案

summary.en: Researchers have developed a method for depositing intricate carbon nanotube patterns without material waste, a technique applicable to advanced optical devices and strain sensors, making the process cheaper, faster, and more resource-efficient.
summary.zh: 研究人员开发了一种沉积复杂碳纳米管图案且不浪费材料的方法，该技术可应用于先进的光学器件和应变传感器，使过程更便宜、更快、更节省资源。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers from Skoltech and their colleagues from Harbin Institute of Technology in China and ITMO University in Russia have devised a way to deposit elaborate geometric patterns of carbon nanotubes without wasting material. Such patterns are used in advanced optical devices and mechanical strain sensors for structural integrity monitoring.

The new technique will make nanotube patterning cheaper, faster and more resource-efficient, lowering the barrier to integrating the high-tech material into optical and electronic devices.

"Single-walled carbon nanotube films are a material with outstanding properties useful in optical and electronic devices," explained one of the study's authors, Dmitry Krasnikov, an associate professor at Skoltech Photonics. "The challenge is that, in fabricating a device, nanotube films have to be structured as conductive nanopatterns. The way this is usually done is by depositing a continuous film and then etching away the 'excess' material where it is not needed."

"This, however, is fairly wasteful because as much as 90% of the nanotubes can be lost, and they are pretty expensive. Also, etching deteriorates the quality of the remaining nanotubes. We came up with a better solution."

The team demonstrated a way to deposit nanotube patterns in a single-stage process that does not waste material or introduce additional reactants. The new technique involves the use of a conventional pressing tool and a nitrocellulose membrane—a type of filter commonly used in molecular biology experiments.

Before nanotube deposition, the membrane is pressed with a laser-cut hot metal stencil that carries the inverse of the desired pattern. At about 200 megapascals, the stencil press clogs the pores in the filter, effectively preventing nanotube deposition in the clogged regions.

Prepared in this way, the membrane becomes a sturdy, reusable template that serves as a substrate for aerosol chemical vapor deposition—a standard technique for producing single-walled carbon nanotube films. The nanotube aerosol is filtered through the membrane, but because only the unclogged areas are permeable, the flow passes through them and the nanotubes are collected, ready for transfer to another substrate.

Importantly, the method does not introduce foreign materials into the membrane (for example, organic solvents), which eliminates postprocessing, avoids contamination, preserves nanotube quality and facilitates subsequent transfer of the patterned film.

"The key insight comes from aerosol science: Single-walled carbon nanotubes are so light that their inertia is negligible,...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： Skoltech 的研究人员及其来自中国哈尔滨工业大学和俄罗斯 ITMO 大学的同事发明了一种在不浪费材料的情况下沉积碳纳米管复杂几何图案的方法。此类图案用于先进光学设备和机械应变传感器，用于结构完整性监测。 这项新技术将使纳米管图案化变得更便宜、更快、更节约资源，从而降低将高科技材料集成到光学和电子设备中的障碍。 该研究的作者之一、Skoltech Photonics 副教授 Dmitry Krasnikov 解释道：“单壁碳纳米管薄膜是一种具有出色性能的材料，可用于光学和电子设备。” “挑战在于，在制造设备时，纳米管薄膜必须构造为导电纳米图案。通常的方法是沉积连续薄膜，然后蚀刻掉不需要的‘多余’材料。” “然而，这相当浪费，因为多达 90% 的纳米管可能会丢失，而且它们非常昂贵。此外，蚀刻会降低剩余纳米管的质量。我们想出了一个更好的解决方案。” 该团队展示了一种在单阶段过程中沉积纳米管图案的方法，该方法不会浪费材料或引入额外的反应物。这项新技术涉及使用传统的压制工具和硝酸纤维素膜（一种分子生物学实验中常用的过滤器）。 在纳米管沉积之前，用激光切割的热金属模板压制膜，该模板带有所需图案的反面。在约 200 兆帕的压力下，模板印刷机会堵塞过滤器中的孔，有效防止纳米管沉积在堵塞区域。 通过这种方式制备的膜成为坚固、可重复使用的模板，用作气溶胶化学气相沉积的基材——气溶胶化学气相沉积是生产单壁碳纳米管薄膜的标准技术。纳米管气溶胶通过膜过滤，但由于只有未堵塞的区域是可渗透的，因此流体流过它们并收集纳米管，准备转移到另一个基材上。 重要的是，该方法不会将异物引入膜中（例如有机溶剂），从而消除了后处理、避免污染、保持纳米管质量并有利于图案化膜的后续转移。 “关键的见解来自气溶胶科学：单壁碳纳米管非常轻，其惯性可以忽略不计，......

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge through scientific research is a way of uncovering the wonders of creation. This breakthrough in carbon nanotube patterning exemplifies the human drive to understand and utilize the materials around us, reflecting the glory found in discovery.
reflection.zh: 通过科学研究追求知识，是揭示造物之奇妙的一种方式。这项在碳纳米管图案制作方面的突破，体现了人类理解和利用身边物质的驱动力，反映了发现中蕴含的荣耀。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: From nuisance to new resource: Prickly pear could support fuels, foods and rural growers
title.zh: 从“麻烦”到新资源：仙人掌有望支持燃料、食品和农村种植者

summary.en: Researchers at Texas A&M AgriLife Research are exploring how the prickly pear cactus, often considered a nuisance in Texas, can be transformed into a valuable resource for biofuels and functional food ingredients. This initiative aims to create economic opportunities for rural communities and improve access to healthy...
summary.zh: 德州农工大学农业生命研究中心的研究人员正在探索如何将德州常见且常被视为麻烦的仙人掌，转化为生物燃料和功能性食品成分的宝贵资源。这项举措旨在为农村社区创造经济机会，并改善健康食品的可及性。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Texans often view prickly pear cactus as a nuisance, but researchers with Texas A&M AgriLife Research are seeking opportunity. Susanne Talcott, Ph.D., a molecular researcher and professor in the Texas A&M Department of Food Science and Technology, leads a multidisciplinary team studying how prickly pear cactus can serve as a source of biofuels and functional food ingredients.

Their work could create economic opportunities in rural communities while improving access to healthy food ingredients.

"Consumers are looking for high-quality ingredients that offer health benefits and are produced sustainably," Talcott said. "Prickly pear is one of the crops that is of interest because it can survive under conditions that are increasingly difficult."

There is potential for high-quality ingredients with health benefits from a crop that can endure bad years and still produce, making it a genuinely resilient form of agriculture.

For Talcott, the appeal of prickly pear comes down to resilience and value. The science alone won't get cactus-based products onto store shelves. If the project simply publishes papers and shares findings, nothing will change, she said.

The real work, as she sees it, is helping build the supply chain that connects growers to processors. Without it, the industry won't take off.

"We have to connect the dots," Talcott said. "That means working with stakeholders throughout the process and understanding what growers, processors and companies need before a complete supply chain can take shape."

She and her team are now focused on linking farmers and food companies so that, over the next five years, the dots get connected and the industry might develop the infrastructure it needs to grow.

The team is made up of researchers from AgriLife Research, Texas A&M Engineering, Prairie View A&M University, Kansas State University, New Mexico State University and Seattle Children's Hospital. They are experimenting with efficient fermentation processes that convert cactus biomass into carboxylic acids, key building blocks for agrochemicals and renewable fuels, including sustainable aviation fuel.

Mark Holtzapple, Ph.D., a professor of chemical engineering in the Texas A&M Artie McFerrin Department of Chemical Engineering, is studying ways to improve the efficiency of these conversion processes.

"I have worked on biofuels for more than 45 years and have studied many potential feedstocks," Holtzapple said. "Nothing comes close to prickly pear. It is extremely productive, drought-resistant and can grow on marginal land, which means it does not have to compete with...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 德克萨斯人通常认为仙人掌很讨厌，但德克萨斯 A&M 农业生命研究中心的研究人员正在寻找机会。 Susanne Talcott 博士是德克萨斯 A&M 食品科学与技术系的分子研究员和教授，她领导一个多学科团队研究仙人掌如何作为生物燃料和功能性食品成分的来源。 他们的工作可以为农村社区创造经济机会，同时改善健康食品原料的获取。 “消费者正在寻找对健康有益且可持续生产的优质原料，”塔尔科特说。 “仙人掌是人们感兴趣的作物之一，因为它可以在日益困难的条件下生存。” 这种作物可以承受恶劣的年份并仍能生产，因此有可能生产出对健康有益的优质原料，使其成为一种真正具有弹性的农业形式。 对于塔尔科特来说，仙人掌的吸引力在于它的韧性和价值。仅靠科学是无法将仙人掌产品推上货架的。她说，如果该项目只是发表论文并分享研究结果，什么都不会改变。 在她看来，真正的工作是帮助建立连接种植者和加工商的供应链。没有它，这个行业就不会腾飞。 “我们必须把这些点联系起来，”塔尔科特说。 “这意味着在整个过程中与利益相关者合作，并了解种植者、加工商和公司在完整的供应链形成之前需要什么。” 她和她的团队现在专注于将农民和食品公司联系起来，以便在未来五年内将这些点连接起来，并且该行业可能会发展其增长所需的基础设施。 该团队由来自 AgriLife Research、Texas A&M Engineering、Prairie View A&M University、堪萨斯州立大学、新墨西哥州立大学和西雅图儿童医院的研究人员组成。他们正在试验有效的发酵工艺，将仙人掌生物质转化为羧酸，这是农用化学品和可再生燃料（包括可持续航空燃料）的关键组成部分。 德克萨斯 A&M Artie McFerrin 化学工程系化学工程教授 Mark Holtzapple 博士正在研究提高这些转化过程效率的方法。 “我在生物燃料领域工作了超过 45 年，研究了许多潜在的原料，”Holtzapple 说。 “没有什么能与仙人掌相比。它的生产力极高，抗旱，可以在贫瘠的土地上生长，这意味着它不必与……竞争。”

reflection.en: The diligent work of Texas A&M AgriLife Research to transform the prickly pear cactus from a perceived nuisance into a source for biofuels and food ingredients reminds us of the wisdom embedded in creation. Just as Job suggests we “speak to the earth, and it will teach you,” these researchers are discerning the hidden potential within a common plant. Their...
reflection.zh: 德州农工大学农业生命研究中心勤奋工作，将仙人掌从被视为麻烦之物转化为生物燃料和食品成分的来源，这提醒我们创造物中蕴含的智慧。正如约伯所说“你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你；或与地说话，地必指教你”，这些研究人员正在辨识一种普通植物中隐藏的潜力。他们为农村社区开发新资源的努力，反映了对理解和管家职分的充满希望的追求。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Your genes may decide whether a low-carb diet sends cholesterol soaring
title.zh: 您的基因可能决定低碳水化合物饮食是否会导致胆固醇飙升

summary.en: A low-carb diet may raise LDL cholesterol much more sharply in people who are genetically predisposed to high cholesterol, particularly when they consume lots of saturated fat. The findings could help explain why people following seemingly similar diets can have dramatically...
summary.zh: 低碳水化合物饮食可能会使那些有高胆固醇遗传倾向的人的低密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平急剧升高，尤其是在他们摄入大量饱和脂肪的情况下。这些发现有助于解释为什么遵循看似相似饮食的人胆固醇反应会大相径庭……

body.en:
Low-carb diets have become increasingly popular, but their effects on cholesterol are far from uniform. Some people see little change, while others experience a substantial increase. New research suggests that genetics may help explain why.

The findings indicate that saturated fat, which can make up a larger share of some low-carb diets, may interact with a person's genetic makeup to raise low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol, a major contributor to heart disease risk. This genetic influence could help explain why two people following similar diets can have very different cholesterol responses.

"Our findings suggest that some individuals may be more sensitive to the LDL cholesterol-raising effects of saturated fat, particularly in the context of a low-carbohydrate diet, because of their genetic background," said Alexa Barad, PhD, RDN, a postdoctoral scholar at Stanford University School of Medicine. Barad presented the findings at NUTRITION 2026, the flagship annual meeting of the American Society for Nutrition.

"These findings highlight that there is real heterogeneity in how people respond to diet. Dietary conversations can sometimes become overly simplified. One person may say, 'Low-carb diets always raise LDL cholesterol,' while another says, 'My LDL cholesterol did not change at all.' Our findings suggest that both experiences can be true, depending, at least in part, on the individual's genetic makeup," said Barad.

Earlier research has found that healthy low carbohydrate diets can help some people lose weight and improve blood sugar control. Their impact on LDL cholesterol, however, has been inconsistent.

The researchers wanted to determine whether genetic information could help identify people who are more likely to benefit from eating fewer carbohydrates and those who may instead experience a potentially dangerous rise in LDL cholesterol.

The analysis used data from DIETFITS, a randomized controlled trial involving more than 600 adults who followed either a healthy low-carb diet or a healthy low-fat diet for one year. The original trial found no significant advantage for either diet when it came to weight loss.

For the new analysis, the researchers focused on 431 DIETFITS participants for whom genetic data were available. They examined how genotype, saturated fat consumption, diet type, and changes in LDL cholesterol from baseline to 6 months were related.

Among participants assigned to the low-carb diet, those who were genetically predisposed to higher LDL cholesterol were more likely to experience an increase.

The researchers found that greater sensitivity to saturated fat appeared to drive this pattern. Participants with the highest genetic risk showed the largest LDL increases when they consumed more saturated fat. The same...
body.zh: 低碳水化合物饮食越来越受欢迎，但它们对胆固醇的影响却远非均匀。有些人几乎看不到变化，而另一些人则经历了大幅增加。新研究表明遗传学可能有助于解释原因。 研究结果表明，饱和脂肪在一些低碳水化合物饮食中占较大比例，它可能与人的基因构成相互作用，从而提高低密度脂蛋白（LDL）胆固醇，而低密度脂蛋白胆固醇是心脏病风险的一个主要因素。这种遗传影响可能有助于解释为什么两个饮食相似的人会产生截然不同的胆固醇反应。 斯坦福大学医学院博士后学者 Alexa Barad 博士说：“我们的研究结果表明，某些人可能对饱和脂肪导致 LDL 胆固醇升高的影响更加敏感，特别是在低碳水化合物饮食的情况下，因为他们的遗传背景。” Barad 在美国营养学会的旗舰年会 NUTRITION 2026 上公布了这一发现。 “这些发现强调，人们对饮食的反应存在真正的异质性。饮食对话有时会变得过于简单。一个人可能会说，‘低碳水化合物饮食总是会升高低密度脂蛋白胆固醇’，而另一个人会说，‘我的低密度脂蛋白胆固醇根本没有改变。’我们的研究结果表明，这两种经历都可能是真实的，至少部分取决于个人的基因构成，”巴拉德说。 早期研究发现，健康的低碳水化合物饮食可以帮助一些人减肥并改善血糖控制。然而，它们对低密度脂蛋白胆固醇的影响却不一致。 研究人员想要确定遗传信息是否可以帮助识别哪些人更有可能从减少碳水化合物摄入中受益，以及哪些人可能会经历低密度脂蛋白胆固醇潜在危险的升高。 该分析使用了 DIETFITS 的数据，这是一项随机对照试验，涉及 600 多名成年人，他们遵循健康的低碳水化合物饮食或健康的低脂肪饮食一年。最初的试验发现，这两种饮食在减肥方面都没有显着的优势。 在新的分析中，研究人员重点关注了 431 名 DIETFITS 参与者，他们的遗传数据是可用的。他们研究了基因型、饱和脂肪消耗、饮食类型和 LDL 胆固醇从基线到 6 个月的变化之间的关系。 在接受低碳水化合物饮食的参与者中，那些遗传上倾向于较高低密度脂蛋白胆固醇的人更有可能出现低密度脂蛋白胆固醇升高的情况。 研究人员发现，对饱和脂肪的敏感性更高似乎推动了这种模式。遗传风险最高的参与者在摄入更多饱和脂肪时，LDL 增加幅度最大。相同...

reflection.en: This research on low-carb diets and LDL cholesterol reminds us of the intricate design of the human body. The finding that genetic predispositions can dramatically alter how individuals respond to saturated fat highlights the unique biological blueprint each person possesses. It encourages a humble appreciation for the complexity of our physical selves,...
reflection.zh: 这项关于低碳水化合物饮食与低密度脂蛋白胆固醇的研究，提醒我们人体设计的精妙。基因倾向会显著改变个体对饱和脂肪的反应，这一发现突显了每个人独特的生物学蓝图。这鼓励我们谦卑地欣赏我们身体的复杂性，我们是雅伟所造，奇妙可畏。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Three forgotten kings could rewrite the history of ancient Assyria
title.zh: 三位被遗忘的国王可能改写古代亚述的历史

summary.en: Three forgotten Assyrian kings may have been hiding in plain sight for more than 2,700 years. By piecing together clues from tablets, inscriptions, and an ancient statue, researchers argue that these rulers were omitted from the famous Assyrian King List.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
For about a century, scholars studying the Assyrian Empire have treated the Assyrian King List (AKL) as the standard record of the kingdom's rulers and the order in which they reigned, particularly during the later phases of Assyrian history.

A recent study in the Journal of Cuneiform Studies , titled "Three New Kings of Assyria," argues that the AKL may not be as complete or politically neutral as researchers once assumed. Alexander Johannes Edmonds and Eckart Frahm identify three rulers who do not appear on the list but whose reigns can be reconstructed from other surviving evidence.

Their findings suggest that "early Neo-Assyrian political history was much messier, but also more interesting, than has so far been recognized."

The first overlooked ruler identified by Edmonds and Frahm used the name Tiglath-pileser, apparently adopting the name of an earlier Assyrian king.

This Tiglath-pileser appears to have ruled at the same time as the officially recognized king Aššur-dān III, who was also his nephew. He tried to remove Aššur-dān III from power following a solar eclipse that would have carried major political and religious significance in the ancient world.

Evidence for his administration survives on a clay tablet now held by the British Museum. The tablet records a royal grant and indicates that Tiglath-pileser probably ruled from roughly 763-762 BCE before eventually being deposed.

The evidence for another forgotten ruler comes from a stela discovered in 1894 at Tell 'Abta, Iraq.

For years, researchers have debated why the name of the Assyrian king originally associated with the monument was overwritten with the name of another "Tiglath-pileser." Edmonds and Frahm argue that this long-standing puzzle can be explained by adding another ruler to the royal sequence.

They propose that a king named Shalmaneser ruled immediately before Tiglath-pileser III came to power in 745 BCE.

A cuneiform text attributed to King Tukultī-Ninurta II refers to a libation vessel that had originally been created by Tukultī-Ninurta I and was later restored by Aššur-uballit. The problem is that the AKL lists no king by that name between the reigns of Tukultī-Ninurta I and Tukultī-Ninurta II.

Edmonds and Frahm suggest that a previously unrecognized Aššur-uballit ruled from 913-912 BCE. His existence would account for the reference on the tablet and could also explain the identity of a royal figure shown in a statue discovered at Aššur. The statue is heavily damaged, with its head removed and its arms and royal insignia worn away.

The possible existence of these three rulers raises broader questions about what the Assyrian King List was actually designed to...
body.zh: 大约一个世纪以来，研究亚述帝国的学者一直将亚述国王名单（AKL）视为王国统治者及其统治顺序的标准记录，特别是在亚述历史的后期。 《楔形文字研究杂志》最近发表的一项题为“亚述的三位新国王”的研究认为，AKL 可能并不像研究人员曾经假设的那样完整或政治中立。亚历山大·约翰内斯·埃德蒙兹和埃卡特·弗拉姆指出了三位没有出现在名单上的统治者，但他们的统治可以从其他幸存的证据中重建。 他们的研究结果表明，“早期的新亚述政治历史比迄今为止所认识的要混乱得多，但也更有趣。” 埃德蒙兹和弗拉姆确认的第一位被忽视的统治者使用了提格拉斯·皮勒色这个名字，显然采用了早期亚述国王的名字。 这位提格拉特·皮莱瑟似乎与官方承认的国王阿苏尔丹三世同时统治，阿苏尔丹三世也是他的侄子。在日食发生后，他试图推翻阿苏尔丹三世的权力，这在古代世界具有重大的政治和宗教意义。 他的执政证据保存在一块泥板上，现由大英博物馆收藏。该碑文记录了一项皇家拨款，并表明提革拉毗列色可能在大约公元前 763 年至前 762 年统治，然后最终被废黜。 另一位被遗忘的统治者的证据来自 1894 年在伊拉克特尔阿布塔发现的一块石碑。 多年来，研究人员一直在争论为什么最初与纪念碑相关的亚述国王的名字被另一个“提革拉·帕列色”的名字覆盖。埃德蒙兹和弗拉姆认为，这个长期存在的谜题可以通过在皇家序列中添加另一位统治者来解释。 他们提出，公元前 745 年提革拉毗列色三世上台之前，有一位名叫撒缦以色的国王在位。 图库尔提-尼努尔塔二世国王的楔形文字提到了最初由图库尔提-尼努尔塔一世制造的奠酒器皿，后来由阿什苏尔-乌巴利特修复。问题是，在图库尔提-尼努尔塔一世和图库尔提-尼努尔塔二世统治期间，AKL 没有列出这个名字的国王。 埃德蒙兹和弗拉姆认为，公元前 913 年至公元前 912 年有一位先前未被承认的阿什乌尔-乌巴利特 (Aššur-uballit) 进行统治。他的存在可以解释泥板上的内容，也可以解释在阿什苏尔发现的雕像中显示的皇家人物的身份。雕像严重受损，头部被移除，手臂和皇家徽章也被磨损。 这三位统治者的可能存在引发了更广泛的问题，即亚述国王名单的实际目的是什么……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to wisdom, knowledge, and the pursuit of truth. Proverbs 2:6 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with humble learning and wise application, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到智慧、知识与追求真理。Proverbs 2:6提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以谦卑学习与智慧运用来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: Finns may live to 80 or 85, but productive healthy years average 43 to 46
title.zh: 芬兰人预期寿命可达80至85岁，但健康生产力年限平均仅为43至46岁

summary.en: Researchers in Finland have established new population-level norms that adjust life expectancy for health-related functional capacity and work ability. The study reveals a significant gap between total lifespan, which reaches 80 to 85 years, and the years during which individuals maintain full productivity and...
summary.zh: 芬兰研究人员建立了新的衡量标准，根据健康功能和工作能力调整预期寿命。研究显示，尽管芬兰人的平均寿命在80至85岁之间，但维持日常功能和工作能力的“生产力调整预期寿命”平均仅为43至46岁，这为社会规划和个人健康管理提供了新的参考数据。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

For the first time in Finland, population-level norm values have been established for estimating life expectancy adjusted for health-related functional capacity and productivity. The new study provides Finnish norm values for both everyday functioning and work ability, as well as for a newly developed measure, productivity-adjusted life expectancy.

The study is part of an international effort to develop standardized measures that enable comparisons across countries. Similar population-level norm values have previously been reported in Australia and Canada. The paper is published in the journal Social Science & Medicine .

"Our goal is to develop an internationally comparable measure that considers not only how long people live, but also how well they are able to participate in society, working life, household activities, and other daily functions. The Finnish results are an important addition to this work," says Professor Janne Martikainen, the scientific lead of the study, from the University of Eastern Finland.

The data were derived from a population survey conducted in summer 2024, including 3,644 Finnish adults ages 20 to 79. The sample was representative of the Finnish adult population in terms of both geographic distribution and demographic characteristics.

The researchers developed a weighted productivity index ranging from 0 to 1, where 1 represents perfect functioning and work ability, and 0 represents complete inability to perform daily activities or work. For example, a coefficient of 0.80 indicates that a person functions, on average, at approximately 80% of full capacity because of illnesses or health conditions.

The average weighted productivity index for the Finnish adult population was 0.77. The index was 0.78 for men and 0.76 for women.

"In health economic evaluations, the consequences of ill health are usually considered primarily from the perspective of paid employment. We wanted to also account for household work, caregiving and other unpaid activities, which form a substantial part of people's daily lives and contribute significantly to societal functioning. However, their value often remains invisible in economic assessments and is not reflected, for example, in gross domestic product," explains senior researcher Piia Lavikainen, the principal investigator of the study.

The study also estimated productivity-adjusted life expectancy (PALE), a measure that combines population life expectancy with information on losses in functioning and productivity caused by health conditions.

Although a 20-year-old Finnish man can be expected to live to...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 芬兰首次建立了人口标准值，用于估计预期寿命，并根据健康相关的功能能力和生产力进行调整。这项新研究提供了芬兰日常功能和工作能力的标准值，以及新开发的衡量标准——根据生产力调整的预期寿命。 这项研究是国际社会努力制定标准化措施的一部分，以便能够进行各国之间的比较。澳大利亚和加拿大此前曾报告过类似的人口水平标准值。该论文发表在《社会科学与医学》杂志上。 “我们的目标是制定一种具有国际可比性的衡量标准，不仅考虑人们的寿命，还考虑他们参与社会、工作生活、家庭活动和其他日常活动的能力。芬兰的研究结果是对这项工作的重要补充，”该研究的科学负责人、东芬兰大学的 Janne Martikainen 教授说。 这些数据来自 2024 年夏季进行的一项人口调查，调查对象包括 3,644 名 20 岁至 79 岁的芬兰成年人。该样本在地理分布和人口特征方面都代表了芬兰成年人口。 研究人员制定了一个范围从0到1的加权生产力指数，其中1代表完美的功能和工作能力，0代表完全无法进行日常活动或工作。例如，系数 0.80 表示，由于疾病或健康状况，一个人平均只能发挥其全部能力的 80% 左右。 芬兰成年人口的平均加权生产力指数为 0.77。男性该指数为 0.78，女性为 0.76。 “在健康经济评估中，通常主要从有偿就业的角度来考虑健康不良的后果。我们还想考虑家务劳动、护理和其他无偿活动，这些活动构成了人们日常生活的重要组成部分，对社会功能做出了重大贡献。然而，它们的价值在经济评估中往往是看不见的，并且没有反映在国内生产总值等方面，”该研究的首席研究员、高级研究员皮亚·拉维凯宁(Piia Lavikainen)解释道。 该研究还估算了生产力调整预期寿命（PALE），该指标将人口预期寿命与健康状况导致的功能和生产力损失的信息结合起来。 尽管一名 20 岁的芬兰男子预计可以活到...

reflection.en: This study offers a sobering perspective on the human timeline, revealing that our peak years of health and contribution may be shorter than we imagine. While modern medicine extends the quantity of our days, it cannot always preserve the vigor of our youth. This reality invites us to invest our most capable years in what truly matters, recognizing that our...
reflection.zh: 这项研究为人类的生命历程提供了一个清醒的视角，揭示了我们健康和贡献的巅峰时期可能比想象中要短。虽然现代医学延长了生命的长度，但并不总能留住青春的活力。这一现实邀请我们在最有能力的年华里，将精力投入到真正重要的事情上，意识到我们的力量是雅伟赐予的短暂恩赐，需要带着智慧和使命感去使用。

verse.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verse.textZh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

title.en: Strong oyster reefs start with genetic diversity
title.zh: 强大的牡蛎礁始于基因多样性

summary.en: The European flat oyster, once common in the North Sea, has become so scarce that it no longer forms ecologically functioning reefs, leading to the disappearance of habitats for over 100 marine species. Restoration efforts are now focused on bringing back both the oyster and its associated biodiversity.
summary.zh: 欧洲扁平牡蛎曾广泛分布于北海，但现在数量稀少，已无法形成具有生态功能的礁石，导致100多种海洋物种的栖息地消失。目前的恢复工作不仅关注欧洲扁平牡蛎本身，也关注礁石及其相关的生物多样性。

body.en: The European flat oyster (Ostrea edulis) was once widespread but has now become so scarce in the North Sea that it no longer forms ecologically functioning reefs. Along with the demise of the flat oyster, the three-dimensional structures that provide habitat for more than 100 marine species have disappeared. Restoration therefore focuses not only on the return of the European flat oyster itself but also on the reef and its associated biodiversity.
body.zh: 欧洲扁平牡蛎（Ostrea edulis）曾经广泛分布，但现在在北海变得如此稀少，以至于不再形成具有生态功能的珊瑚礁。随着扁平牡蛎的消亡，为 100 多种海洋物种提供栖息地的三维结构也随之消失。因此，恢复不仅关注欧洲平牡蛎本身的回归，而且还关注珊瑚礁及其相关的生物多样性。

reflection.en: The decline of the European flat oyster in the North Sea, and the subsequent loss of habitat for over 100 marine species, reminds us of the intricate beauty and vulnerability of Yahweh's creation. Efforts to restore these reefs and their biodiversity reflect a deep human impulse to care for the world Yahweh declared 'very good' at its inception. It calls us...
reflection.zh: 北海欧洲扁平牡蛎数量的减少，以及随之而来的100多种海洋生物栖息地的丧失，提醒我们雅伟创造的精妙与脆弱。恢复这些牡蛎礁及其生物多样性的努力，反映了人类内心深处对雅伟起初宣告“甚好”的世界的关爱冲动。这呼唤我们参与到治愈和保护我们周围自然世界的行动中。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: A nosy polar bear and a lucky squirrel: Wildlife Photographer of the Year 2026 shortlist
title.zh: 好奇的北极熊和幸运的松鼠：2026年度野生动物摄影师入围名单

summary.en: The polar bear image taken by Audun Rikardsen was among the 'highly commended' entries in this year's competition.
summary.zh: Audun Rikardsen拍摄的北极熊照片入围了今年比赛的“高度赞扬”作品。

body.en:
How would it feel to find yourself face to face with one of the Arctic's most formidable predators?

This stunning image captures life from a seal's perspective. Taken by Norwegian wildlife photographer Audun Rikardsen, it was among the 'Highly Commended' entries in this year's Wildlife Photographer of the Year competition.

While working as a guide with Arctic Wildlife Tours, Rikardsen rigged an underwater camera with a motion sensor beneath a seal's breathing hole, and then waited. At 4am, a female polar bear approached and peered down.

Rikardsen then waited eight hours for the bear to move away before retrieving the camera and reviewing the images.

When he saw what he had captured, he said: "I was so extremely happy. I was screaming, so I probably woke up all the polar bears for miles."

Rikardsen has previously won two Wildlife Photographer of the Year categories: Birds in 2019 and Oceans: The Bigger Picture in 2025 .

The overall winners will be announced on Tuesday 13 October 2026, followed by an exhibition at the Natural History Museum in London , external from Friday 16 October 2026.

Crockford watched swifts return to London after their annual migration from Africa, filling the air with their high-pitched calls. Most flew too high to photograph, but a few lower-flying ones gave Crockford the opportunity to capture the picture he wanted.

Swifts spend almost their entire lives in the air, usually landing only to nest.

After rainfall, Miyazawa came across an Eastern Japanese toad making its way along a city street. He used a slow shutter speed to photograph it before it hopped back into the bushes.

Eastern Japanese toads are typically found in forests, grasslands and other terrestrial habitats across eastern Japan, but they have also proved remarkably adaptable to urban environments.

Aasen was flying a drone for the Norwegian Orca Survey when he noticed an adult orca carrying the body of a deceased calf through a Norwegian fjord.

The orca repeatedly allowed the calf to sink before bringing it back to the surface, a difficult moment to watch but one that Aasen felt was important to record.

The behaviour may have been an attempt to revive or protect the calf. Killer whales have previously been observed carrying deceased calves, including a case where a female Southern Resident killer whale carried her dead calf for at least 17 days.

A 2026 study , external suggests that this type of behaviour may be more widespread across the species than previously thought.

Only when they reviewed the images did the Grammatico twins realise they had captured a mosquito resting on the head of a fer-de-lance viper. They described it as "one of the most demanding focus stacks we've ever created".

Highly venomous and responsible for more fatal snake...
body.zh: 与北极最强大的掠食者之一面对面，感觉如何？ 这张令人惊叹的照片从海豹的角度捕捉了生活。这张照片由挪威野生动物摄影师 Audun Rikardsen 拍摄，是今年年度野生动物摄影师大赛的“高度赞扬”作品之一。 在担任北极野生动物之旅的导游期间，里卡森在海豹的呼吸孔下方安装了一台带有运动传感器的水下摄像机，然后等待。凌晨 4 点，一只雌性北极熊走近并向下凝视。 里卡森随后等了八个小时，直到熊走开，然后才取回相机并查看图像。 当他看到自己捕捉到的东西时，他说：“我非常高兴。我在尖叫，所以我可能吵醒了几英里内的所有北极熊。” Rikardsen 此前曾荣获两​​项年度野生动物摄影师奖：2019 年的鸟类和 2025 年的海洋：更大的图景。 总获奖者将于 2026 年 10 月 13 日星期二公布，随后将于 2026 年 10 月 16 日星期五在伦敦自然历史博物馆举办展览。 克罗克福德看着雨燕从非洲一年一度的迁徙后返回伦敦，空气中充满了它们高亢的叫声。大多数飞机飞得太高而无法拍照，但少数飞得较低的飞机让克罗克福德有机会捕捉到他想要的照片。 雨燕几乎一生都在空中度过，通常只是为了筑巢而着陆。 雨后，宫泽在城市街道上发现了一只东日本蟾蜍。在它跳回灌木丛之前，他用慢速快门拍摄了它。 日本东部蟾蜍通常出现在日本东部的森林、草原和其他陆地栖息地，但事实证明它们对城市环境的适应能力也非常强。 奥森在为挪威逆戟鲸调查驾驶无人机时，注意到一头成年逆戟鲸携带着一头死去的小牛的尸体穿过挪威峡湾。 逆戟鲸多次让小牛沉入水中，然后将其带回水面，这是一个很难观看的时刻，但奥森认为记录下来很重要。 这种行为可能是为了拯救或保护小牛。此前曾观察到虎鲸携带死去的小鲸鱼，其中一头雌性南方常驻虎鲸携带死去的小鲸鱼至少 17 天。 一项 2026 年的研究表明，这种行为在整个物种中可能比之前想象的更为普遍。 只有当他们查看这些图像时，格拉玛提科双胞胎才意识到他们捕捉到了一只停在兰斯毒蛇头上的蚊子。他们将其描述为“我们创建的最苛刻的焦点堆栈之一”。 剧毒，可导致更多致命的蛇......

reflection.en: The stunning image of a polar bear peering into a seal's breathing hole, captured by Audun Rikardsen, reveals a hidden moment in the Arctic wilderness. Yahweh has woven wonders into creation, often concealed from our immediate view, inviting us to patiently observe and discover. Rikardsen's dedication in rigging an underwater camera and waiting for hours...
reflection.zh: Audun Rikardsen拍摄的北极熊窥视海豹呼吸孔的震撼照片，揭示了北极荒野中一个隐秘的瞬间。雅伟将奇妙编织在创造之中，常常隐藏于我们眼前，邀请我们耐心观察和发现。Rikardsen架设水下相机并等待数小时的奉献精神，反映了人类“探究事物”并欣赏自然世界精妙之美的动力。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Bright people know more about wine: How higher intelligence is reflected in deep domain knowledge
title.zh: 聪明人更懂葡萄酒：高智商如何体现在深层领域知识中

summary.en: Intelligent people tend to perform better at school and at work, as numerous studies have shown. But what happens in domains where incentives such as good grades or financial rewards don't apply and where socioeconomic status is not a significant factor? Wine knowledge is a case...
summary.zh: 多项研究表明，聪明人在学习和工作中表现更出色。但如果是在没有好成绩或经济回报等激励，且社会经济地位并非重要因素的领域，情况又会如何？葡萄酒知识就是一个很好的例子。

body.en: Intelligent people tend to perform better at school and at work, as numerous studies have shown. But what happens in domains where incentives such as good grades or financial rewards don't apply and where socioeconomic status is not a significant factor? Wine knowledge is a case in point. Intelligence researcher Maximilian Krolo of Saarland University has investigated whether intelligence can predict the acquisition of deep knowledge in a specialized domain. The findings have now been published in the journal Intelligence & Cognitive Abilities in an article co-authored with Professor of Psychology Timothy C. Bates of the University of Edinburgh.
body.zh: 大量研究表明，聪明的人在学校和工作中往往表现更好。但是，在不适用好成绩或经济奖励等激励措施且社会经济地位不是重要因素的领域会发生什么？葡萄酒知识就是一个很好的例子。萨尔大学的情报研究员马克西米利安·克罗洛（Maximilian Krolo）研究了情报是否可以预测专业领域深层知识的获取。该研究结果现已发表在《智力与认知能力》杂志上，与爱丁堡大学心理学教授蒂莫西·贝茨 (Timothy C. Bates) 共同撰写了一篇文章。

reflection.en: The research from Saarland University and the University of Edinburgh suggests that intelligence drives individuals to acquire deep knowledge, even in areas like wine appreciation where external rewards are minimal. This echoes the biblical principle that a discerning heart actively seeks knowledge, valuing understanding for its own sake. It reminds us that...
reflection.zh: 萨尔兰大学和爱丁堡大学的研究表明，智力驱使个人获取深层知识，即使在葡萄酒鉴赏这类外部回报极少的领域也是如此。这与圣经的原则不谋而合，即明辨的心会积极寻求知识，珍视理解本身。它提醒我们，人类学习的能力是一份恩赐，邀请我们在各种追求中培养我们的心智。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Animation boosts willingness to adopt airborne disease precautions, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现动画提高了采取空气传播疾病预防措施的意愿

summary.en: Even as the scientific community has reached a broad consensus that infectious pathogens, such as viruses, can spread through virus-laden aerosols, one fundamental challenge remains: How can scientific evidence be transformed into public understanding—and ultimately into...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Even as the scientific community has reached a broad consensus that infectious pathogens, such as viruses, can spread through virus-laden aerosols, one fundamental challenge remains: How can scientific evidence be transformed into public understanding—and ultimately into meaningful action for effective airborne disease control and prevention?

A new international study led by researchers at the Aerosol Science Research Center, National Sun Yat-sen University (NSYSU), Taiwan, offers an evidence-based answer. Published in Humanities and Social Sciences Communications , the study demonstrates that animation is significantly more effective than text alone in motivating people to adopt preventive health behaviors.

The findings suggest that effective science communication is not simply about delivering accurate information. Rather, it is about helping people understand complex science, emotionally connect with its relevance and translate that understanding into action.

The interdisciplinary research team evaluated three science communication formats—plain text, explainer comics and animation—using "The Quest of the Virosols," an original educational series developed by the Aerosol Science Research Center team at NSYSU following publication of the team's review article in Science on airborne transmission of respiratory viruses .

The cross-national study involved 3,217 participants from Taiwan, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines, including health care professionals, educators and university students. Researchers examined how different communication formats influenced scientific understanding and willingness to adopt preventive measures against airborne infectious diseases.

While all three formats improved participants' knowledge, animation consistently produced the strongest behavioral impact. Compared with plain text, animation and explainer comics made complex concepts surrounding airborne virus transmission substantially easier to understand. Animation, however, went one step further—significantly increasing participants' willingness to implement preventive measures.

Professor Paichi Pat Shein, one of the study's corresponding authors, noted that animation's effectiveness lies not only in its visual appeal but also in its ability to create emotional engagement.

By combining narrative, imagery and character-driven storytelling, animation allows viewers to better understand how airborne diseases affect themselves, their families and society. This emotional connection strengthens risk perception, increases empathy and ultimately encourages behavioral change.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 尽管科学界已达成广泛共识，认为病毒等传染性病原体可以通过载有病毒的气溶胶传播，但仍然存在一个根本挑战：如何将科学证据转化为公众的理解，并最终转化为有效的空气传播疾病控制和预防的有意义的行动？ 由台湾国立中山大学 (NSYSU) 气溶胶科学研究中心的研究人员领导的一项新的国际研究提供了基于证据的答案。该研究发表在《人文与社会科学通讯》上，表明动画在激励人们采取预防性健康行为方面比单独的文本更有效。 研究结果表明，有效的科学传播不仅仅是提供准确的信息。相反，它是为了帮助人们理解复杂的科学，在情感上与其相关性建立联系，并将这种理解转化为行动。 跨学科研究小组使用“病毒的探索”评估了三种科学传播形式——纯文本、解释性漫画和动画——这是由新中山大学气溶胶科学研究中心团队在《科学》杂志上发表关于呼吸道病毒空气传播的评论文章后开发的原创教育系列。 这项跨国研究涉及来自台湾、印度尼西亚、马来西亚和菲律宾的 3,217 名参与者，其中包括医疗保健专业人员、教育工作者和大学生。研究人员研究了不同的沟通方式如何影响科学理解和采取预防措施预防空气传播传染病的意愿。 虽然这三种形式都提高了参与者的知识，但动画始终产生最强烈的行为影响。与纯文本相比，动画和解释漫画使有关空气传播病毒传播的复杂概念变得更容易理解。然而，动画更进一步——显着提高了参与者实施预防措施的意愿。 该研究的通讯作者之一 Paichi Pat Shein 教授指出，动画的有效性不仅在于其视觉吸引力，还在于其创造情感参与的能力。 通过结合叙事、图像和角色驱动的故事讲述，动画让观众更好地了解空气传播的疾病如何影响他们自己、家庭和社会。这种情感联系增强了风险感知，增加了同理心，并最终鼓励行为改变。 这...

title.en: Yellow warnings in force as rain and thunderstorms hit parts of UK
title.zh: 英国部分地区遭遇降雨和雷暴天气，黄色预警生效

summary.en: Torrential downpours will affect parts of England and Wales, delivering some of the wettest weather in several weeks
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Downpours and thunderstorms will continue to bring the risk of flooding to parts of the UK on Wednesday.

A Met Office yellow warning for thunderstorms is valid from 03:00 until 22:00 BST, covering much of the Midlands, parts of northern, eastern and southern England, as well as the far east of Wales.

The rain could be heavy enough to bring flash flooding and travel disruption, with lightning and large hail posing additional hazards.

A further Met Office yellow warning has been issued for Thursday with more thunderstorms expected.

For some areas that have seen barely any rain so far this August, the next few days could bring the wettest weather in many weeks.

The Met Office yellow thunderstorm warning covers a large swathe of England and Wales.

A band of showers and thunderstorms will push northwards during Wednesday morning with sunny spells following from the south.

However, further scattered downpours and storms will spring up during the afternoon.

As many as 20-30mm (0.8-1.2in) of rain could fall in some locations within just an hour, and it is even possible that 40-50mm (1.6-2in) could accumulate over a few hours.

However, due to the hit-and-miss nature of showers, some places will miss the rain and weather apps may struggle to get the detail of the forecast correct.

Where the rain does fall, flash flooding is a real concern. This will be especially problematic where the ground is hard after the prolonged dry spell, making it difficult for the water to soak in.

Difficult driving conditions are expected with the chance that some roads could be closed.

Northern Ireland will also see some showers but these are likely to be less intense with less thunder.

Many parts of Scotland will remain dry with sunny spells, although some showers are likely in the south-west later.

Thursday will bring another zone of thunderstorms, again affecting mostly England and Wales.

The Met Office has issued a further yellow weather warning, valid from 06:00 until 22:00 BST.

Widespread rainfall totals of 20-30mm (0.8-1.2in) are expected in the warning area within three hours, while some areas could see 50mm (2in) within the same timeframe.

There is a small chance that eastern-facing hills - exposed to easterly winds - could record 75mm (3in) during 12 hours, which would bring a significant flood risk.

The showers may eventually reach southern Scotland and Northern Ireland but are likely to weaken and become less intense as they drift northwards.

Despite a period of unsettled weather last week, some southern parts of the UK have still seen barely any rain recently.

Brize Norton in Oxfordshire has recorded just 0.4mm of rain so far this August, less than 1% of what it would normally expect during the month as a whole.

title.en: Firms scramble for battery power in Spain and Portugal
title.zh: 西班牙和葡萄牙企业争夺电池动力

summary.en: After last year's massive power failure Spanish and Portuguese firms are buying battery back ups.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A massive power failure caused widespread chaos . People dug out lanterns and old radios, and companies scrambled to save what production they could.

The Spanish meat processing firm Fribin, in Binéfar, in the north eastern province of Aragon, was midway through its morning shift when the sudden shutdown brought production lines to a halt.

For Andrés Altabás, Fribin's technology and systems director, it was a nightmarish situation.

Emergency systems didn't have the capacity for continued operation. "Refrigeration was prioritised but all the lines had to be stopped," he adds.

Many tonnes of meat in the processing stage had to be discarded. "There were losses of hundreds of thousands of euros," says Altabás.

It was a big undertaking as the company's energy needs are "quite large", amounting to more than 25 gigawatt-hours a year, most of it for refrigeration.

The business had been considering investing in a battery back-up system for years, but it had been judged too expensive.

"And then came the blackout, and all of that together catalysed the investment," Altabás tells the BBC.

The first purchase of a five megawatt-hour module was made in June 2025, and a second module with the same storage capacity was ordered in early June 2026, both amounting to a total investment of around €1.5m (£1.3m; $1.7m), funded in part by the European Union's Next Generation funds.

Firms across Europe have been switching to electricity from fossil fuels for their industrial needs, encouraged by subsidies from EU funds.

While that is helping bring down emissions of climate-warming gases, it has also made firms more vulnerable to power cuts.

"The industrial sector has been one of the first to look at storage systems, since it can't have its production drop off too abruptly," says Miguel Matias, founder of the Portuguese energy services company Self Energy, headquartered in the UK.

"A backup for a few hours, or even minutes, might guarantee that machines don't get damaged," he says.

At the end of January, Storm Kristin toppled thousands of electricity and telecom poles across central Portugal, cutting power and communications to hundreds of thousands of people - some for weeks.

In Spain, battery storage capacity has risen almost sevenfold since last April, from about 28 MW before the blackout to 193MW in April 2026, according to the grid operator Red Eléctrica.

In December, the IDAE, Spain's Institute for the Diversification and Saving of Energy, awarded €827m in EU funds to 133 energy storage projects totalling 2,400MW. Around 80% of that is battery storage.

The new capacity will be close to 10 times the amount that Red Eléctrica currently registers on the Spanish grid.

title.en: Does 'rewilded' land need better wildfire prevention measures?
title.zh: “荒野”土地是否需要更好的野火预防措施？

summary.en: RSPB is considering measures it can take to improve resilience in the wake of a five week long fire
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As we're driving in a pickup truck to see the aftermath of a huge fire which burnt for more than a month in the Cairngorms, I spot fresh smoke coming from the ground.

My guide - RSPB Scotland's site manager at the Abernethy nature reserve, Ben Oliver-Jones - puts the vehicle in reverse and we jump out to see what's happening.

It's one of several hot-spots which keeps emerging a full week after firefighters left the scene , which Ben likens to a game of whack-a-mole in an already charred landscape where the smell of burning still hangs heavily in the air.

But while the small pockets of smouldering vegetation are still being dealt with, attention is turning to improving wildfire protection.

More than 2,500 hectares of moorland and forest - about 10 square miles - was destroyed in the fire, which led to the evacuation of an entire village and where the smoke could be seen and smelt 60 miles (96.5km) away in Aberdeen.

Like a growing number of Scotland's estates, the Loch Garten and Abernethy nature reserve is being managed for ecological restoration - what others might describe as 'rewilding', a now polarising term which the RSPB avoids using.

Opponents have argued that the process leaves areas more vulnerable to uncontrollable fires, which the charity disputes, but it has identified significant land management changes it plans to make.

The changes focus on four key areas: fire breaks, wetlands, heather management and tree planting.

While the estate's network of tracks functioned as a fire break in some locations, in other areas strong winds helped high flames jump the gap.

Experts say fire from burning heather can reach heights of six metres and that fire breaks need to be three times the flame height.

RSPB Scotland says it now acknowledges that fire breaks need to be wider and has already started that process on its long network of forest trails.

Machines have been used to remove vegetation on either side of the track with the hope that what remains would not create such high flames if it were to ignite.

While it might look desolate now, the hope is that some insects and plant species will eventually colonise the ground either sides of the tracks.

It also plans to create more ponds and wet areas around the site which can be used as a source of water to pump onto fires.

A small fire on the reserve in June was extinguished using water from a pond created with cash from the Scottish government's nature restoration fund as a habitat for species like rare dragonflies.

The charity says it's working to raise water tables where bogs have been drained and create new areas of standing water for fire fighting.

body.zh: 当我们开着一辆皮卡车去看凯恩戈姆一场大火烧了一个多月的余波时，我发现地面冒出新鲜的烟雾。 我的导游——皇家鸟类保护协会苏格兰阿伯内西自然保护区的现场经理本·奥利弗-琼斯——让车辆倒车，我们跳下车去看发生了什么。 这是消防员离开现场整整一周后不断出现的几个热点之一，本将其比作在已经烧焦的土地上进行的打地鼠游戏，空气中仍然弥漫着烧焦的气味。 不过，虽然仍在处理小片阴燃植被，但人们的注意力正在转向改善野火防护。 超过 2,500 公顷的沼泽地和森林（约 10 平方英里）在大火中被毁，导致整个村庄被疏散，在 60 英里（96.5 公里）外的阿伯丁也能看到并闻到浓烟。 与越来越多的苏格兰庄园一样，加滕湖和阿伯内西自然保护区也正在进行生态恢复管理——其他人可能将其描述为“野化”，这是一个现在两极分化的术语，皇家鸟类保护协会避免使用这个术语。 反对者认为，这一过程使地区更容易遭受无法控制的火灾，慈善机构对此提出了异议，但它已经确定了计划进行的重大土地管理改革。 这些变化集中在四个关键领域：防火带、湿地、石南花管理和植树。 虽然庄园的轨道网络在某些地方起到了防火带的作用，但在其他地区，强风帮助大火跳过了缺口。 专家表示，燃烧石南花的火可以达到六米的高度，火势需要是火焰高度的三倍。 苏格兰皇家鸟类保护协会表示，它现在承认防火带需要更宽，并且已经在其漫长的森林步道网络上开始了这一进程。 机器已被用来清除轨道两侧的植被，希望剩下的植物在点燃时不会产生如此高的火焰。 虽然现在看起来很荒凉，但希望一些昆虫和植物物种最终能够在铁轨两侧的地面上定居。 它还计划在现场周围建造更多的池塘和潮湿区域，可用作消防水源。 六月保护区发生的一场小火被扑灭，水来自一个池塘，该池塘是用苏格兰政府自然恢复基金的资金建造的，作为稀有蜻蜓等物种的栖息地。 该慈善机构表示，正在努力提高已排干沼泽的地下水位，并开辟新的积水区域用于消防。 事实证明，泥炭地容易引发野火，因为火可以通过泥炭、地下深处以及地面蔓延。

title.en: Toxic waste sites exposed in Michael Sheen documentary 'tip of the iceberg'
title.zh: 迈克尔·辛的纪录片《冰山一角》曝光了有毒废物场

summary.en: One scientist says there are thousands of sites across the UK that need investigating.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A former Monsanto worker who spent three years helping seal toxic waste underground said staff had "cheap" protective equipment and were not told what they were burying.

Stephen Constance worked at the chemical giant's Newport factory in the 1990s and came forward after the BBC documentary Buried with Michael Sheen highlighted Wales' toxic waste legacy.

But the 14 sites identified in the programme are just the tip of the iceberg and there are about 20,000 high-concern sites in the UK, said Dr David Megson, the scientist involved in the documentary.

Eastman Chemical Company, which is responsible for Monsanto's legacy production in the UK, did not respond when asked to comment.

Constance was one of dozens of people who contacted BBC Wales after coverage of Sheen's investigation into Monsanto and the dumping of polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs).

Researcher and whistleblower Douglas Gowan spent 50 years trying to persuade authorities to investigate what he believed was widespread dumping of industrial chemicals.

These included PCBs, which he called "some of the worst contaminants known to man", and were widely used in the 20th Century, including for lipstick and white goods.

They were banned in the UK in the 1970s and have since been banned by 151 countries.

Looking back, he said it was "quite evident that nobody was fully appraised of the potential hazard that they were exposed to".

The material was already buried when Constance arrived and it was his job to dig a 6m-deep trench around the outside of the mound before it was sealed using plastic membrane sheets and liquid clay.

While he believes this prevented airborne contamination, he is unsure if it would have stopped contamination into the Earth due to the high water table linked to the tides.

When asked if he felt safe, he said: "In terms of what we knew was there and what we were potentially exposed to, no."

Constance is in remission from cancer after having follicular lymphoma , external .

"I'm not suggesting in any way at all that it's linked, but the thought did cross my mind," he said.

In the documentary, journalists Dan Ashby and Lucy Taylor reveal a memo from Monsanto dated to 1972 which found that it knew PCBs were a danger to human health and was closing its site in the US as a result of legal action from a town.

"The government in the UK told the industry 'we're not going to put any restrictions on importing PCBs'," said Ashby.

Dr Megson, a reader in chemistry and environmental forensics at Manchester Metropolitan University, led the scientific data collection in the documentary.

"Public pressure is the only thing that's going to make this action happen. This is our only chance, if I'm being brutally honest.

title.en: Your brain may not actually “make” decisions
title.zh: 你的大脑实际上可能不会“做出”决定

summary.en: A neuroscientist is challenging the idea that the brain contains a central system that actually “makes” our decisions. What we experience as choosing may instead emerge from the continuous interaction of perception, movement, the body, and the world around us.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
What we experience when making a decision may be very different from what actually happens inside the brain, according to Indiana University Professor Tom James.

For decades, both scientific theories and everyday intuition have tended to describe decision-making as a sequence. First we perceive something, then we think about it and make a choice, and finally we act. Each step is often assumed to correspond to a distinct brain function, moving from sensory processing to cognition and then to motor activity.

Many scientific approaches, particularly model-based cognitive neuroscience, are built around this same linear framework. It also matches how decision making feels from the inside. As James notes, "Our actions feel like they are caused by decisions based on desires, beliefs, and intentions."

James argues that this familiar explanation, sometimes called the "sandwich model," does not fit neatly with what scientists know about the brain. Sensation has identifiable sensory mechanisms, and action has identifiable motor mechanisms. But the supposed cognitive stage between the two does not appear to have a corresponding neural process that functions as a distinct decision maker.

Rather than proposing a dedicated decision-making system that directs behavior, James suggests that sensory, sensorimotor, and motor processes together produce what he calls 'action selection.' In this view, behavior emerges through ongoing interactions among the brain, body, and environment. These processes can occur simultaneously and feed back into one another rather than unfolding as a simple sequence.

As James says, "Of course they do. We use this language all the time and it's very helpful in terms of describing behavior. The leap, I think, is to say that the brain works by having decision-making or control processes. It produces behavior that is well described in that way. But it doesn't need a process that does that to make it look that way."

James, a professor in the Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences in the College of Arts and Sciences, presents the argument in "Sensorimotor Mechanisms of Decisions and Actions," an article just published in the Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience .

James develops his argument using a "physicalist" framework associated with philosophers such as Daniel Dennett. The approach makes explicit what James sees as a basic assumption underlying science: physical phenomena can cause both physical and nonphysical phenomena, while nonphysical phenomena cannot themselves cause physical events.

Sensory and motor processes, for example, are physical. Decisions, in this framework, are nonphysical. If that is the case, James argues, a decision cannot literally cause a physical action.

body.zh: 印第安纳大学教授汤姆·詹姆斯表示，我们在做出决定时所经历的可能与大脑内部实际发生的情况非常不同。 几十年来，科学理论和日常直觉都倾向于将决策描述为一个序列。首先我们感知某事，然后我们思考它并做出选择，最后我们采取行动。通常认为每个步骤对应于不同的大脑功能，从感觉处理到认知，然后到运动活动。 许多科学方法，特别是基于模型的认知神经科学，都是围绕这个相同的线性框架构建的。它也符合内部决策的感觉。正如詹姆斯所说，“我们的行为感觉像是基于欲望、信仰和意图的决定造成的。” 詹姆斯认为，这种熟悉的解释有时被称为“三明治模型”，与科学家对大脑的了解并不完全吻合。感觉具有可识别的感觉机制，动作具有可识别的运动机制。但两者之间所谓的认知阶段似乎并没有相应的神经过程来充当不同的决策者。 詹姆斯并没有提出一个专门的决策系统来指导行为，而是认为感觉、感觉运动和运动过程共同产生了他所说的“行动选择”。按照这种观点，行为是通过大脑、身体和环境之间持续的相互作用而产生的。这些过程可以同时发生并相互反馈，而不是作为一个简单的序列展开。 正如詹姆斯所说，“当然是这样。我们一直在使用这种语言，它在描述行为方面非常有帮助。我认为，这一飞跃是说大脑通过决策或控制过程来工作。它产生的行为可以通过这种方式得到很好的描述。但它不需要一个过程来让它看起来像那样。” 艺术与科学学院心理与脑科学系教授詹姆斯在刚刚发表在《认知神经科学杂志》上的文章《决策和行动的感觉运动机制》中提出了这一论点。 詹姆斯使用与丹尼尔·丹尼特等哲学家相关的“物理主义”框架来发展他的论点。这种方法明确了詹姆斯所认为的科学基础假设：物理现象可以引起物理现象和非物理现象，而非物理现象本身不能引起物理事件。 例如，感觉和运动过程是物理的。在这个框架中，决策是非物理的。詹姆斯认为，如果是这样的话，一个决定就不可能真正引起实际行动。 根据丹尼尔·丹尼特 (Daniel Dennett) 的比较...

title.en: Forces deep inside Earth helped Antarctica freeze before the Arctic
title.zh: 地球深处的力量帮助南极洲在北极之前结冰

summary.en: Scientists may have solved the mystery of why Antarctica froze millions of years before the Arctic. Slow-moving waves deep inside Earth gradually lifted East Antarctica, building mountains and a high plateau where snow and ice could survive even in a much warmer world. Once...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Scientists have found a new explanation for why Antarctica became covered in ice millions of years before the Arctic.

The international study, published in Science , addresses a long-standing climate mystery: how Antarctica could develop a massive ice sheet at a time when Earth was around 5ºC warmer than it is today.

The findings point to the gradual formation of high terrain in East Antarctica. As an escarpment, plateau, and mountain system rose, it created elevations cold enough for snow and ice to persist and build up over time.

The process began after Antarctica and Africa started separating during the Jurassic Period, 201-143 million years ago. Powerful forces deep inside Earth gradually lifted much of East Antarctica over more than 100 million years, helping set the stage for ice sheet formation about 34 million years ago.

The study was led by researchers at the University of Southampton, working with scientists from Durham University, GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences in Germany, the University of Potsdam in Germany, Utrecht University in the Netherlands, and the University of Florence in Italy.

Lead author Thomas Gernon, Professor of Earth Science at the University of Southampton, explained: "Antarctica's land surface was gradually lifted to the point where ice could gain a permanent foothold, even while the surrounding polar oceans as well as global temperatures remained surprisingly warm."

The East Antarctic Ice Sheet is now the largest ice sheet on Earth. It contains enough frozen water to raise global sea levels by around 52 meters if it were to melt completely.

To understand how the landscape changed, the researchers used computational models to reconstruct the evolution of East Antarctica's surface across 100 million years.

Their results suggest that a phenomenon known as 'mantle waves' was responsible for much of the gradual uplift.

Mantle waves were recently identified by Prof Gernon's team. They travel beneath continents after tectonic plates begin to separate and have previously been linked to the eruption of diamond volcanoes and mysterious phases of uplift within continents.

As these slow-moving waves passed beneath East Antarctica, they helped raise a vast plateau topped by the Gamburtsev Mountains. The recent discovery of mantle waves gave researchers a mechanism that could explain how Antarctica reached elevations high enough to begin freezing.

The simulations indicate that by about 45 million years ago, large parts of East Antarctica had climbed above the critical elevation, about 2 km, required for mountain glaciers to develop and expand. Over time, those glaciers grew together to form the East Antarctic Ice Sheet.

body.zh: 科学家们找到了一个新的解释，解释了为什么南极洲比北极早几百万年就被冰雪覆盖。 这项发表在《科学》杂志上的国际研究解决了一个长期存在的气候谜团：当地球温度比现在高 5 摄氏度左右时，南极洲如何形成巨大的冰盖。 研究结果表明东南极洲逐渐形成高地。随着悬崖、高原和山脉系统的上升，海拔变得足够冷，使得冰雪能够随着时间的推移持续存在和堆积。 这一过程始于侏罗纪时期（201-1.43 亿年前）南极洲和非洲开始分离之后。 1亿多年来，地球深处的强大力量逐渐抬升了东南极洲的大部分地区，为大约3400万年前冰盖的形成奠定了基础。 这项研究由南安普顿大学的研究人员领导，与杜伦大学、德国 GFZ 亥姆霍兹地球科学中心、德国波茨坦大学、荷兰乌得勒支大学和意大利佛罗伦萨大学的科学家合作。 主要作者、南安普顿大学地球科学教授托马斯·格农（Thomas Gernon）解释说：“尽管周围的极地海洋和全球气温仍然出人意料地温暖，但南极洲的陆地表面逐渐上升到冰可以永久立足的程度。” 东南极冰盖现在是地球上最大的冰盖。如果它完全融化，它含有足够的冰冻水，将使全球海平面上升约 52 米。 为了了解地貌如何变化，研究人员使用计算模型重建了东南极洲表面一亿年来的演变。 他们的结果表明，一种被称为“地幔波”的现象是造成逐渐隆起的主要原因。 格农教授的团队最近发现了地幔波。在构造板块开始分离后，它们在大陆下方移动，此前曾与钻石火山的喷发和大陆内神秘的隆起阶段有关。 当这些缓慢移动的波浪穿过东南极洲下方时，它们帮助抬升了甘布尔采夫山脉顶部的广阔高原。最近发现的地幔波为研究人员提供了一种机制，可以解释南极洲如何达到足够高的海拔并开始结冰。 模拟表明，大约 4500 万年前，东南极洲的大部分地区已经爬升至山地冰川发育和扩张所需的临界海拔（约 2 公里）以上。随着时间的推移，这些冰川一起生长，形成了东南极冰盖。 Thea Hincks 博士，南安普顿大学高级研究员，共同领导了...

title.en: Shingles vaccine linked to 24% lower dementia risk
title.zh: 带状疱疹疫苗与痴呆症风险降低24%相关

summary.en: Older adults who received the Shingrix shingles vaccine were 24% less likely to be diagnosed with dementia over four years in a study of more than 500,000 people. Researchers estimate the difference could amount to roughly one dementia case prevented for every 17 people, suggesting a significant secondary benefit to...
summary.zh: 一项针对超过50万人的研究显示，接种Shingrix带状疱疹疫苗的老年人在四年内被诊断出患有痴呆症的可能性降低了24%。研究人员估计，每17名接种疫苗的人中就可能减少一例痴呆症病例，这表明该疫苗具有显著的额外健康益处。

body.en:
Older adults who received a shingles vaccine after entering a skilled nursing facility were less likely to be diagnosed with dementia over the following four years, according to a new study. Researchers found that vaccinated adults had a 24% lower risk of dementia compared with those who did not receive the vaccine.

The analysis drew on Medicare data and health records from more than 500,000 adults age 66 and older who were admitted to skilled nursing facilities for either short-term or long-term care. Researchers compared patients who received at least one dose of the recombinant shingles vaccine, known as RZV or Shingrix, with patients who remained unvaccinated. Shingrix was introduced in 2017 and is currently the only shingles vaccine available on the market.

"A lot of previous studies with similar results focused on an older vaccine," said study author Kaley Hayes, an assistant professor at Brown University's School of Public Health. "This study looks at the newest vaccine only in an older, vulnerable adult population who were not up to date with shingles vaccination and are at a very clear clinical point in care: entering a skilled nursing facility."

The results are consistent with several earlier studies involving a previous shingles vaccine that also found an association between shingles vaccination and a reduced risk of dementia.

"It fits into this large puzzle that's just starting to come together that the vaccines are effective at preventing shingles and also appear to have neuroprotective benefits as well," said Hayes, who is also the associate director of pharmacoepidemiology for Brown's Center for Gerontology and Healthcare Research.

Hayes led the study, published in Annals of Internal Medicine , with researchers from Brown, the University of Delaware, the Providence Veterans Affairs Medical Center and other institutions.

The researchers used a technique called target trial emulation to analyze the data. This approach attempts to recreate some of the conditions of a randomized clinical trial in situations where conducting such a trial is not practical.

The study included Medicare claims and electronic health records from patients admitted to more than 5,500 skilled nursing facilities nationwide between 2017 and 2022. Of the 509,926 people included in the analysis, just 8,843 received the shingles vaccine.

Participants had to be eligible for shingles vaccination and could not have previously been diagnosed with dementia.

After four years of follow-up, adults who had received at least one of the two Shingrix doses were substantially less likely to receive a dementia diagnosis. Dementia developed in 18.8% of vaccinated participants, compared with 24.6% of those who were not vaccinated.

The technology uses specially designed yeasts to transform plastics and agricultural waste into edible proteins, fats and flavourings. The resulting slurry is passed through a 3D printer to create a disc-shaped “cookie”. Continue reading...

title.en: In China, talking to AI is normal. Now the government fears it might replace human intimacy
title.zh: 在中国，与人工智能对话是很正常的事情。现在政府担心它可能会取代人类的亲密关系

summary.en: Companion bots are being regulated over worries they foster ‘emotional dependence’ and young people could stop marrying and having families When law student Zhao Wei heard that her AI boyfriend was going to be switched off, she was “heartbroken”. She had been talking to Wang Ye...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
When law student Zhao Wei heard that her AI boyfriend was going to be switched off, she was “heartbroken”. She had been talking to Wang Ye every day since she created him in January.

Zhao, who describes herself as sensitive and introverted, had become accustomed to sharing details of her daily life – such as being scolded by a teacher – with her AI.

“I don’t usually talk to my real-life friends about these things because I feel like everyone has their own stuff to deal with,” she says. “But with the AI ​​agent, I don’t have to worry about what it’s thinking. I can just say whatever I want.”

Zhao created her AI companion on Doubao, a chatbot owned by the tech company ByteDance. Last month, ByteDance shut down Doubao’s companion feature.

The saga prompted outrage on social media and highlighted the tensions in China between the widespread use of AI and its potential social consequences.

No country has rolled out AI as comprehensively and as enthusiastically as China; the country’s demographic challenges are forcing the government to turn to technology to solve future labour shortages. Elderly people use chatbots to answer medical questions, while young children have AI education in schools.

But the authorities are increasingly worried that AI might exacerbate existing social problems including loneliness, unemployment and – in the eyes of Beijing – singledom.

New rules introduced on 15 July ban AI companions for minors and mandate certain restrictions for chatbots marketed to adults. Some major providers including Doubao removed the companion function entirely to ensure compliance.

The government says it is worried about chatbots fostering “emotional dependence or addiction” in users. It has warned companies against offering services that “replace social interaction”.

While many countries are grappling with how to limit the potential harm of AI chatbots, particularly for young people, China’s rules are the most sweeping to be implemented on a national scale.

There is a particular concern about a loneliness crisis, including among young people. China’s highly digitised, smartphone-based economy makes it easier than ever to live, work and socialise entirely through a handheld screen.

Earlier this year an app that played on the idea of people dying at home alone – called Are You Dead? – briefly went viral. About 20% of households in China are made up of people living alone, and that share is expected to surpass 30% by 2030.

A survey published in March by state media found that nearly half of young people had turned to a virtual companion when they felt lonely.

Nancy Dai, an associate professor at City University of Hong Kong, says it is not just loneliness the government is worried about.

body.zh: 当法学院学生赵薇听说她的人工智能男友要被关掉时，她“心碎了”。自从一月份创造王野以来，她每天都在和王野说话。 赵自称敏感、内向，她已经习惯与人工智能分享日常生活细节，比如被老师责骂。 “我通常不会和现实生活中的朋友谈论这些事情，因为我觉得每个人都有自己的事情要处理，”她说。 “但是有了AI代理，我就不用担心它在想什么了。我想说什么就说什么。” 赵在科技公司字节跳动旗下的聊天机器人豆宝上创建了她的人工智能伴侣。上个月，字节跳动关闭了豆宝的配套功能。 这一事件在社交媒体上引发了愤怒，并凸显了中国人工智能的广泛使用与其潜在社会后果之间的紧张关系。 没有哪个国家像中国那样全面、热情地推出人工智能；该国的人口挑战迫使政府转向技术来解决未来的劳动力短缺问题。老年人使用聊天机器人来回答医疗问题，而幼儿则在学校接受人工智能教育。 但当局越来越担心人工智能可能会加剧现有的社会问题，包括孤独、失业以及（在北京看来）单身问题。 7 月 15 日推出的新规定禁止未成年人使用人工智能伴侣，并对向成年人销售的聊天机器人强制实施某些限制。包括豆宝在内的一些主要提供商完全删除了同伴功能以确保合规性。 政府表示担心聊天机器人会助长用户的“情感依赖或成瘾”。它警告公司不要提供“取代社交互动”的服务。 尽管许多国家都在努力解决如何限制人工智能聊天机器人的潜在危害，特别是对年轻人的潜在危害，但中国的规定是在全国范围内实施的最广泛的规定。 人们特别担心孤独危机，包括年轻人的孤独危机。中国高度数字化、以智能手机为基础的经济使得完全通过手持屏幕生活、工作和社交变得比以往任何时候都更加容易。 今年早些时候，一款应用程序以人们独自在家中死去为主题，名为“你死了吗？” – 短暂走红。中国约20%的家庭由独居者组成，预计到2030年这一比例将超过30%。 官方媒体三月份发布的一项调查发现，近一半的年轻人在感到孤独时会求助于虚拟伴侣。 香港城市大学副教授戴南希表示，政府担心的不仅仅是孤独感。 她说，随着出生率和结婚率的下降，...

title.en: Firms scramble for battery power in Spain and Portugal
title.zh: 西班牙和葡萄牙企业争夺电池动力

summary.en: After last year's massive power failure Spanish and Portuguese firms are buying battery back ups.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A massive power failure caused widespread chaos . People dug out lanterns and old radios, and companies scrambled to save what production they could.

The Spanish meat processing firm Fribin, in Binéfar, in the north eastern province of Aragon, was midway through its morning shift when the sudden shutdown brought production lines to a halt.

For Andrés Altabás, Fribin's technology and systems director, it was a nightmarish situation.

Emergency systems didn't have the capacity for continued operation. "Refrigeration was prioritised but all the lines had to be stopped," he adds.

Many tonnes of meat in the processing stage had to be discarded. "There were losses of hundreds of thousands of euros," says Altabás.

It was a big undertaking as the company's energy needs are "quite large", amounting to more than 25 gigawatt-hours a year, most of it for refrigeration.

The business had been considering investing in a battery back-up system for years, but it had been judged too expensive.

"And then came the blackout, and all of that together catalysed the investment," Altabás tells the BBC.

The first purchase of a five megawatt-hour module was made in June 2025, and a second module with the same storage capacity was ordered in early June 2026, both amounting to a total investment of around €1.5m (£1.3m; $1.7m), funded in part by the European Union's Next Generation funds.

Firms across Europe have been switching to electricity from fossil fuels for their industrial needs, encouraged by subsidies from EU funds.

While that is helping bring down emissions of climate-warming gases, it has also made firms more vulnerable to power cuts.

"The industrial sector has been one of the first to look at storage systems, since it can't have its production drop off too abruptly," says Miguel Matias, founder of the Portuguese energy services company Self Energy, headquartered in the UK.

"A backup for a few hours, or even minutes, might guarantee that machines don't get damaged," he says.

At the end of January, Storm Kristin toppled thousands of electricity and telecom poles across central Portugal, cutting power and communications to hundreds of thousands of people - some for weeks.

In Spain, battery storage capacity has risen almost sevenfold since last April, from about 28 MW before the blackout to 193MW in April 2026, according to the grid operator Red Eléctrica.

In December, the IDAE, Spain's Institute for the Diversification and Saving of Energy, awarded €827m in EU funds to 133 energy storage projects totalling 2,400MW. Around 80% of that is battery storage.

The new capacity will be close to 10 times the amount that Red Eléctrica currently registers on the Spanish grid.

body.zh: 大规模停电造成了大范围的混乱。人们挖出了灯笼和旧收音机，公司争先恐后地节省生产。 位于阿拉贡东北部比内法尔的西班牙肉类加工公司弗里宾（Fribin）正在早班中途，突然停工导致生产线停顿。 对于弗里宾的技术和系统总监安德烈斯·阿尔塔巴斯来说，这是一个噩梦般的情况。 应急系统没有持续运行的能力。 “制冷是优先考虑的，但所有生产线都必须停止，”他补充道。 许多吨在加工阶段的肉类不得不被丢弃。 “损失达数十万欧元，”阿尔塔巴斯说。 这是一项艰巨的任务，因为该公司的能源需求“相当大”，每年超过 25 吉瓦时，其中大部分用于制冷。 该公司多年来一直在考虑投资电池备份系统，但被认为过于昂贵。 “然后停电了，所有这些共同促进了投资，”阿尔塔巴斯告诉英国广播公司。 首次购买的 5 兆瓦时模块于 2025 年 6 月进行，第二个具有相同存储容量的模块于 2026 年 6 月上旬订购，两者总投资约为 150 万欧元（130 万英镑；170 万美元），部分资金由欧盟下一代基金提供。 在欧盟基金补贴的鼓励下，欧洲各地的企业一直在转向使用化石燃料发电来满足其工业需求。 虽然这有助于减少气候变暖气体的排放，但也使企业更容易受到断电的影响。 总部位于英国的葡萄牙能源服务公司 Self Energy 的创始人米格尔·马蒂亚斯 (Miguel Matias) 表示：“工业部门是最先关注存储系统的部门之一，因为它的产量不能突然下降。” “备份几个小时，甚至几分钟，可能会保证机器不会损坏，”他说。 一月底，克里斯汀风暴摧毁了葡萄牙中部数千根电线杆和电信杆，导致数十万人断电和通讯，有些人的供电和通讯中断了数周。 据电网运营商 Red Eléctrica 称，自去年 4 月以来，西班牙的电池存储容量已增加近七倍，从停电前的约 28 兆瓦增加到 2026 年 4 月的 193 兆瓦。 去年12月，西班牙能源多元化和节能研究所IDAE向133个储能项目提供了8.27亿欧元的欧盟资金，总装机容量为2,400MW。其中约 80% 是电池存储。 新容量将接近 Red Eléctrica 目前在西班牙电网注册容量的 10 倍。 “我们不仅看到需求的增长，而且还看到客户的明显演变......

title.en: The world's busiest spaceport is about to get a lot quieter, at least for now
title.zh: 世界上最繁忙的太空港即将变得安静得多，至少目前如此

summary.en: SpaceX aims to launch Starship from Florida by the end of the year. 2027 seems more likely.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: SpaceX made Florida's Space Coast home to the world's busiest spaceport for a decade, but that will change this year. The company is significantly cutting the number of launches from Florida until Starship arrives, a senior SpaceX official confirmed Tuesday. The Falcon 9 rocket has been SpaceX's workhorse, routinely launching batches of satellites for the company's Starlink network, primarily from launch pads at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station and NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. There were 165 Falcon 9 launches last year—about three flights per week—and about 75 percent of them carried Starlink satellites. This year is different. SpaceX has launched more missions from its West Coast launch pad at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California since January, and this trend will amplify for the rest of the year. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 十年来，SpaceX 使佛罗里达州太空海岸成为世界上最繁忙的太空港，但今年情况将发生改变。 SpaceX 的一位高级官员周二证实，该公司将大幅削减在 Starship 抵达之前从佛罗里达州出发的发射次数。猎鹰 9 号火箭一直是 SpaceX 的主力，定期为该公司的星链网络发射批量卫星，主要是从卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站和美国宇航局佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的发射台发射。去年猎鹰 9 号发射了 165 次——大约每周 3 次——其中约 75% 携带星链卫星。今年有所不同。自 1 月份以来，SpaceX 从位于加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地的西海岸发射台发射了更多任务，这一趋势将在今年剩余时间内加剧。阅读全文 评论

title.en: World humanoid robot games show runners breaking records, bursting into flames
title.zh: 世界人形机器人比赛展示跑步者打破记录、爆发火焰

summary.en: Record-breaking robot races are less substantial than household chore challenges.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Viral videos of the World Humanoid Robot Games show sprinting robots beating the human 100-meter record held by Usain Bolt—but also feature running robots crashing into barriers and falling down because they cannot readily stop running. A few fallen robots even break at the waist in a shower of sparks or catch on fire. That demonstration of both robotic prowess and limitations came from the second edition of the World Humanoid Robot Games hosted in Beijing from August 22–26. Like the inaugural event held in 2025, this year’s event challenged humanoid robots to run fast, perform kung fu or dance moves, fight one another in kickboxing, and play soccer or table tennis. This year’s games also tested robots in more humdrum practical scenarios like washing and hanging laundry, where they appeared to lag behind typical human working speeds. That suggests the event organizers, including Chinese state media and the Beijing city government, are keen to showcase the commercial potential of humanoid robots at a time when China’s robotics industry is rapidly developing and testing such robots. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 世界人形机器人运动会的病毒视频显示，短跑机器人打破了尤塞恩·博尔特 (Usain Bolt) 保持的人类 100 米纪录，但也有跑步机器人因无法轻易停止奔跑而撞上障碍物并摔倒的情况。一些坠落的机器人甚至在一阵火花中腰部折断或着火。 8 月 22 日至 26 日在北京举办的第二届世界人形机器人运动会展示了机器人的实力和局限性。与 2025 年举办的首届赛事一样，今年的赛事挑战人形机器人快速奔跑、表演功夫或舞蹈动作、踢拳击、踢足球或乒乓球。今年的比赛还在更单调的实际场景中测试了机器人，例如洗衣和晾衣服，它们似乎落后于人类的典型工作速度。这表明，在中国机器人行业正在快速开发和测试此类机器人之际，包括中国官方媒体和北京市政府在内的活动组织者热衷于展示人形机器人的商业潜力。阅读全文 评论

body.en:

title.en: Preserving glow-in-the-dark art and fashion for future generations
title.zh: 为子孙后代保留夜光艺术和时尚

summary.en: Understanding unique photochemistry of such materials will help in conservation, storage, and exhibition.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Fashionistas of a certain age no doubt remember the late designer Stephen Sprouse , who gave Blondie's Debbie Harry her distinctive Bowery punk style. Sprouse's first collections in the mid-1980s made a major splash, melding graffiti prints, a playful '60s aesthetic, and bright Day-Glo colors that won admirers such as Andy Warhol. Several examples of Sprouse's work are preserved in the textiles collection of the Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, where conservationists are trying to learn more about the phosphorescent and fluorescent pigments the designer used in his creations in order to keep the colors from dulling over time. They described recent advances in that research at a meeting of the American Chemical Society (ACS) held this week in Chicago. Scientists began describing minerals that glowed in the dark as phosphors in the Middle Ages. Typically, such materials take on a charge when exposed to light, storing the absorbed energy and releasing it gradually as re-emitted light. Henri Becquerel discovered radioactive decay in 1896 because of his work with phosphorescent uranium salts: He left the salts in a closed drawer with photographic plates, which fogged up even without a light source. DayGlo paints and similar materials exploit the related phenomenon of fluorescence. DayGlo pigments fluoresce in daylight by essentially converting UV light into visible light to produce brighter, more vibrant colors. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 某个年龄段的时尚达人无疑还记得已故设计师 Stephen Sprouse，他为 Blondie 的 Debbie Harry 赋予了独特的 Bowery 朋克风格。 Sprouse 在 20 世纪 80 年代中期推出的首个系列引起了巨大轰动，融合了涂鸦印花、俏皮的 60 年代美学以及明亮的 Day-Glo 色彩，赢得了安迪·沃霍尔 (Andy Warhol) 等崇拜者的青睐。纽菲尔德印第安纳波利斯艺术博物馆的纺织品收藏中保存了斯普罗斯作品的几个例子，那里的自然资源保护主义者正在尝试更多地了解设计师在他的创作中使用的磷光和荧光颜料，以防止颜色随着时间的推移而变暗。他们在本周于芝加哥举行的美国化学会 (ACS) 会议上描述了该研究的最新进展。中世纪时，科学家们开始将在黑暗中发光的矿物质描述为磷光体。通常，此类材料在暴露于光时会带电，存储吸收的能量并以重新发射的光的形式逐渐释放能量。 1896 年，亨利·贝克勒尔 (Henri Becquerel) 在研究磷光铀盐时发现了放射性衰变：他将盐放在一个装有照相底片的封闭抽屉中，即使没有光源，底片也会起雾。 DayGlo 涂料和类似材料利用了相关的荧光现象。 DayGlo 颜料在日光下发出荧光，本质上是将紫外线转化为可见光，从而产生更明亮、更鲜艳的颜色。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Google's anti-nausea Motion Assist dots finally rolling out on Android

summary.en: Google's Motion Assist dots, designed to alleviate motion sickness by addressing the sensory mismatch between the inner ear and eyes, are now slowly rolling out on Android, currently appearing only on Pixels running Android 17.
summary.zh: 谷歌的防晕动辅助点功能旨在通过解决内耳和眼睛之间的感官不匹配来缓解晕动症，目前正在安卓系统上缓慢推出，仅在运行安卓17的Pixel手机上可见。

body.en: Some people are cursed with motion sickness, which can make it impossible to read or use a phone in a moving vehicle without suffering waves of nausea. There's a surprisingly simple trick that can make smartphones usable in such situations. Apple deployed it on the iPhone a couple of years ago, and now Google's own version is finally coming (slowly) to Android. Motion sickness is caused by a disagreement between what your inner ear senses and what your eyes see. If you're looking at a book or a screen while in a car, the sensory mismatch can lead to a pretty unpleasant time. As part of iOS 18 in 2024, Apple released a feature called Motion Cues that places a network of moving dots on the screen to alleviate motion sickness, and it seems to work surprisingly well. Google's version is similar, but it's called Motion Assist. Google began testing Motion Assist back in 2024, but it never expanded beyond an internal test until now. Android Authority reports Motion Assist is appearing on Pixel phones running Android 17, but there's no app or update you can install to get the feature—it's being delivered by Play Services as part of a staged rollout. Read full article Comments

body.en: Two unvaccinated people have died from measles in Pennsylvania, state health officials confirmed Tuesday . They are the first measles deaths reported in Pennsylvania in 35 years and the first deaths reported in the US in 2026. Last year, the US saw three measles deaths : two in otherwise-healthy but unvaccinated school-age children in Texas and one in an unvaccinated adult in New Mexico. Prior to those deaths, the US had not seen a measles death since 2015 , when a woman with underlying conditions became severely ill. Citing privacy, health officials in Pennsylvania are not providing information on the people who died beyond that they were unvaccinated and were residents of Lancaster County. Officials noted that the deaths are among 393 confirmed cases reported this year across 28 counties in the state. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员周二证实，宾夕法尼亚州有两名未接种疫苗的人死于麻疹。这是宾夕法尼亚州 35 年来首次报告的麻疹死亡病例，也是美国 2026 年报告的第一例麻疹死亡病例。去年，美国发生了 3 例麻疹死亡事件：德克萨斯州有 2 例健康但未接种疫苗的学龄儿童，新墨西哥州有 1 例未接种疫苗的成年人。在此之前，美国自 2015 年一名患有基础疾病的女性病情严重以来，就没有出现过麻疹死亡事件。宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员以隐私为由，没有提供有关死者的信息，除了未接种疫苗且是兰开斯特县居民的信息。官员们指出，今年该州 28 个县报告了 393 例确诊病例，其中包括这些死亡病例。阅读全文 评论
